transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 cit3 ceoi4 maang4 coeng4 ge3 sau2 seot6?
translation: 你有冇做過切除盲腸嘅手術？

english: Has anyone in your family had bowel or stomach cancer?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jan4 jau5 mou5 waan6 gwo3 coeng4 ngaam4 waak6 ze2 wai6 ngaam4?
translation: 你屋企人有冇患過腸癌或者胃癌？

english: Have you had a colonoscopy before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 daai6 coeng4 geng3?
translation: 你以前有冇做過大腸鏡？

english: Do you have any food allergies or intolerances?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 deoi3 mau5 di1 sik6 mat6 man5 gam2 waak6 ze2 m4 noi6 sau6?
translation: 你有冇對某啲食物敏感或者唔耐受？

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4?
translation: 你最近有冇去旅行？

english: Have you eaten any food that may have been spoiled?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 gwo3 ho2 nang4 bin3 waai6 zo2 ge3 sik6 mat6?
translation: 你有冇食過可能變壞咗嘅食物？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: nei5 ping4 si4 ding6 si4 sik6 di1 me1 joek6?
translation: 你平時定時食啲咩藥？

english: Do you take ibuprofen, naproxen, or aspirin?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 ibuprofen, naproxen waak6 ze2 aspirin?
translation: 你有冇食 ibuprofen、naproxen 或者 aspirin？

english: Do you take blood thinners?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 bok6 hyut3 joek6?
translation: 你有冇食薄血藥？

english: Have you taken antibiotics recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 sik6 gwo3 kong3 saang1 sou3?
translation: 你最近有冇食過抗生素？

english: Have you started any new medicine or supplement?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 hoi1 ci2 sik6 san1 joek6 waak6 ze2 bou2 cung1 zai1?
translation: 你有冇開始食新藥或者補充劑？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jam2 zau2?
translation: 你有冇飲酒？

english: How much alcohol do you usually drink in a week?
transliteration: nei5 ping4 si4 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4 jam2 gei2 do1 zau2?
translation: 你平時一個星期飲幾多酒？

english: Have you ever had problems because of alcohol?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jan1 wai6 jam2 zau2 ji4 ceot1 man6 tai4?
translation: 你以前有冇試過因為飲酒而出問題？

english: Is your abdominal pain severe right now?
transliteration: nei5 ji4 gaa1 go3 tou5 tung3 dak1 jim4 m4 jim4 zung6?
translation: 你而家個肚痛得嚴唔嚴重？

english: Is your abdomen hard or very tender to touch?
transliteration: nei5 go3 tou5 mo2 lok6 heoi3 hai6 mai6 ngaang6 waak6 ze2 hou2 tung3?
translation: 你個肚摸落去係咪硬或者好痛？

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 wan4 dai1 waak6 ze2 gok3 dak1 hou2 wan4?
translation: 你有冇暈低或者覺得好暈？

english: Are you vomiting blood?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 au2 hyut3?
translation: 你有冇嘔血？

english: Are you passing black, tarry stool?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 o1 hak1 sik1, ci5 paak3 jau4 ge3 daai6 bin6?
translation: 你有冇痾黑色、似柏油嘅大便？

english: Are you passing a large amount of blood in your stool?
transliteration: nei5 daai6 bin6 jau5 mou5 daai6 loeng6 ceot1 hyut3?
translation: 你大便有冇大量出血？

english: Are you unable to pass stool or gas?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 jyun4 cyun4 o1 m4 ceot1 daai6 bin6 waak6 ze2 fong3 m4 dou2 pei3?
translation: 你係咪完全痾唔出大便或者放唔到屁？

english: Have you stopped passing urine or are you urinating much less?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 mou5 zoi3 siu2 bin6, waak6 ze2 siu2 bin6 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1?
translation: 你係咪冇再小便，或者小便少咗好多？

english: Do you have fever with severe abdominal pain?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1, tung4 si4 tou5 tung3 dak1 hou2 jim4 zung6?
translation: 你有冇發燒，同時肚痛得好嚴重？

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ho2 nang4 waai4 jan6?
translation: 你有冇可能懷孕？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 joeng5 wo6.
translation: 請你仰臥。

english: Please bend your knees slightly.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 mei4 mei4 wat1 hei2 sat1 tau4.
translation: 請你微微屈起膝頭。

english: Please lift your shirt so I can examine your abdomen.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 laai1 hei2 gin6 saam1, dang2 ngo5 gim2 caa4 nei5 go3 tou5.
translation: 請你拉起件衫，等我檢查你個肚。

english: I am going to listen to your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 teng1 haa5 nei5 go3 tou5 ge3 seng1.
translation: 我而家會聽下你個肚嘅聲。

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 hing1 hing1 on3 nei5 go3 tou5.
translation: 我而家會輕輕按你個肚。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: ngo5 on3 ni1 dou6 go2 zan6, jyu4 gwo2 tung3 zau6 waa6 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 我按呢度嗰陣，如果痛就話我知。

english: Does it hurt more when I let go?
transliteration: ngo5 fong3 sau2 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 gang3 gaa1 tung3?
translation: 我放手嗰陣會唔會更加痛？

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 sam1 fu1 kap1.
translation: 請你深呼吸。

english: I may need to examine your rectum, and I will explain why first.
transliteration: ngo5 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 zik6 coeng4, zi1 cin4 wui5 sin1 gaai2 sik1 jyun4 jan1.
translation: 我可能需要檢查你嘅直腸，之前會先解釋原因。

english: We would like to do some blood tests.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 bong1 nei5 jim6 hyut3.
translation: 我哋想幫你驗血。

english: We need a stool sample.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 fan6 daai6 bin6 joeng6 bun2.
translation: 我哋需要一份大便樣本。

english: Please collect a stool sample in this container.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 zoeng1 daai6 bin6 joeng6 bun2 fong3 jap6 ni1 go3 jung4 hei3.
translation: 請你將大便樣本放入呢個容器。

english: We may need an ultrasound of your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 nei5 ziu3 fuk1 bou6 ciu1 sing1 bo1.
translation: 我哋可能需要幫你照腹部超聲波。

english: We may need a CT scan of your abdomen.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 nei5 ziu3 fuk1 bou6 din6 nou5 sou3 miu4.
translation: 我哋可能需要幫你照腹部電腦掃描。

english: A gastroscopy uses a small camera to look inside your food pipe and stomach.
transliteration: wai6 geng3 wui5 jung6 jat1 zi1 sai3 sai3 ge3 geng3 tau4, tai2 nei5 ge3 sik6 dou6 tung4 wai6 jap6 min6.
translation: 胃鏡會用一支細細嘅鏡頭，睇你嘅食道同胃入面。

english: A colonoscopy uses a camera to look inside your large intestine.
transliteration: daai6 coeng4 geng3 wui5 jung6 geng3 tau4 tai2 nei5 ge3 daai6 coeng4 jap6 min6.
translation: 大腸鏡會用鏡頭睇你嘅大腸入面。

english: You may need to take bowel preparation before the colonoscopy.
transliteration: zou6 daai6 coeng4 geng3 zi1 cin4, nei5 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 sik6 cing1 coeng4 joek6.
translation: 做大腸鏡之前，你可能需要食清腸藥。

english: You may need to avoid eating or drinking before the procedure.
transliteration: zou6 gim2 caa4 zi1 cin4, nei5 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 bei6 min5 sik6 je5 waak6 ze2 jam2 je5.
translation: 做檢查之前，你可能需要避免食嘢或者飲嘢。

english: We will explain the risks and ask for your consent before the procedure.
transliteration: zou6 gim2 caa4 zi1 cin4, ngo5 dei6 wui5 gaai2 sik1 fung1 him2, bing6 zing1 kau4 nei5 tung4 ji3.
translation: 做檢查之前，我哋會解釋風險，並徵求你同意。

english: We will give you fluids to prevent dehydration.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bei2 nei5 bou2 cung1 seoi2 fan6, bei6 min5 tyut3 seoi2.
translation: 我哋會畀你補充水分，避免脫水。

english: Take small sips of water frequently.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 mat6 mat6 jam2, mui5 ci3 jam2 siu2 siu2 seoi2.
translation: 請你密密飲，每次飲少少水。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 on3 zoek6 cyu5 fong1 sik6 ni1 zek3 joek6.
translation: 請你按照處方食呢隻藥。

english: This medicine may help reduce stomach acid.
transliteration: ni1 zek3 joek6 ho2 nang4 ho2 ji5 gaam2 siu2 wai6 syun1.
translation: 呢隻藥可能可以減少胃酸。

english: Avoid foods that make your symptoms worse.
transliteration: bei6 min5 sik6 ling6 nei5 zing3 zong6 gaa1 zung6 ge3 sik6 mat6.
translation: 避免食令你症狀加重嘅食物。

english: Do not take painkillers such as ibuprofen unless your clinician advises it.
transliteration: ceoi4 fei1 ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 gin3 ji5, fau2 zaak3 m4 hou2 sik6 ibuprofen ni1 leoi6 zi2 tung3 joek6.
translation: 除非醫護人員建議，否則唔好食 ibuprofen 呢類止痛藥。

english: We may refer you to a digestive system specialist.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 wui5 zyun2 gaai3 nei5 heoi3 tai2 siu1 faa3 hai6 tung2 zyun1 fo1 ji1 sang1.
translation: 我哋可能會轉介你去睇消化系統專科醫生。

english: If you develop severe pain or bleeding, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: Jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hoi1 ci2 jau5 jim4 zung6 tung3 coeng3 waak6 ze2 ceot1 hyut3, cing2 zik1 hak1 heoi3 kau4 ji1.
translation: 如果你開始有嚴重痛楚或者出血，請即刻去求醫。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 je5 soeng2 man6?
translation: 你有冇嘢想問？

english: Can you tell me what symptoms would make you seek urgent help?
transliteration: Nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1, jau5 me1 zing3 zong6 wui5 ling6 nei5 zik1 hak1 heoi3 kau4 zo6?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知，有咩症狀會令你即刻去求助？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: Ngo5 dei6 wui5 bong1 nei5 on1 paai4 fuk6 can2.
translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: Jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ge3 zing3 zong6 gaa1 zung6, cing2 faan1 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1.
translation: 如果你嘅症狀加重，請返嚟睇醫生。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: Do1 ze6 nei5 gam1 jat6 tung4 ngo5 king1 gai2.
translation: 多謝你今日同我傾偈。

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: Nei5 hou2, ngo5 hai6 nei5 ji1 liu4 tyun4 deoi6 ge3 jat1 jyun4.
translation: 你好，我係你醫療團隊嘅一員。

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: Nei5 gam1 jat6 dim2 gaai2 lai4 ni1 dou6?
translation: 你今日點解嚟呢度？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your urinary health.
transliteration: Ngo5 soeng2 man6 nei5 gei2 tiu4 gwaan1 jyu1 bei3 niu6 gin6 hong1 ge3 man6 tai4.
translation: 我想問你幾條關於泌尿健康嘅問題。

english: Some questions may be personal; is that okay?
transliteration: Jau5 di1 man6 tai4 ho2 nang4 bei2 gaau3 si1 jan4, gam2 joeng6 ho2 ji5 maa3?
translation: 有啲問題可能比較私人，咁樣可以嗎？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: Ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 zou6 gim2 caa4 maa3?
translation: 我可以幫你做檢查嗎？

english: Would you like a chaperone present for the examination?
transliteration: Gim2 caa4 ge3 si4 hau6, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jau5 kei4 taa1 ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 pui4 zyu6 nei5?
translation: 檢查嘅時候，你想唔想有其他醫護人員陪住你？

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: Nei5 seoi1 m4 seoi1 jiu3 cyun4 jik6 jyun4?
translation: 你需唔需要傳譯員？

english: When did the problem begin?
transliteration: Ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2?
translation: 呢個問題幾時開始？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: Hai6 dat6 jin4 hoi1 ci2, ding6 hai6 maan6 maan6 hoi1 ci2?
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: How long have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 ni1 di1 zing3 zong6 gei2 noi6 laa3?
translation: 你有呢啲症狀幾耐喇？

english: Are the symptoms getting better or worse?
transliteration: Di1 zing3 zong6 jau5 mou5 hou2 zyun2, ding6 hai6 caa1 zo2?
translation: 啲症狀有冇好轉，定係差咗？

english: Does the problem come and go?
transliteration: Ni1 go3 man6 tai4 wui5 m4 wui5 si4 jau5 si4 mou4?
translation: 呢個問題會唔會時有時無？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: Nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4?
translation: 你以前有冇試過呢個問題？

english: What concerns you most about these symptoms?
transliteration: Ni1 di1 zing3 zong6 jap6 min6, nei5 zeoi3 daam1 sam1 ge3 hai6 me1?
translation: 呢啲症狀入面，你最擔心嘅係咩？

english: Are you urinating more often than usual?
transliteration: Nei5 heoi3 siu2 bin6 ge3 ci3 sou3 jau5 mou5 bei2 ping4 si4 do1?
translation: 你去小便嘅次數有冇比平時多？

english: How many times do you urinate during the day?
transliteration: Nei5 jat6 tau4 heoi3 gei2 do1 ci3 siu2 bin6?
translation: 你日頭去幾多次小便？

english: How many times do you wake at night to urinate?
transliteration: Nei5 je6 maan5 wui5 seng2 gei2 do1 ci3 heoi3 siu2 bin6?
translation: 你夜晚會醒幾多次去小便？

english: Do you suddenly feel an urgent need to urinate?
transliteration: Nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 dat6 jin4 hou2 gap1 soeng2 heoi3 siu2 bin6?
translation: 你會唔會突然好急想去小便？

english: Can you hold your urine until you reach the toilet?
transliteration: Nei5 heoi3 dou3 ci3 so2 zi1 cin4 jan2 m4 jan2 dou2 niu6?
translation: 你去到廁所之前忍唔忍到尿？

english: Are you passing more urine than usual?
transliteration: Nei5 siu2 bin6 ge3 loeng6 jau5 mou5 bei2 ping4 si4 do1?
translation: 你小便嘅量有冇比平時多？

english: Are you passing less urine than usual?
transliteration: Nei5 siu2 bin6 ge3 loeng6 jau5 mou5 bei2 ping4 si4 siu2?
translation: 你小便嘅量有冇比平時少？

english: When did you last pass urine?
transliteration: Nei5 soeng6 jat1 ci3 siu2 bin6 hai6 gei2 si4?
translation: 你上一次小便係幾時？

english: Does it burn or hurt when you urinate?
transliteration: Nei5 siu2 bin6 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 jau5 zoek3 jit6 gam2 waak6 ze2 tung3?
translation: 你小便嗰陣會唔會有灼熱感或者痛？

english: Do you have pain in your lower abdomen?
transliteration: Nei5 haa6 fuk1 jau5 mou5 tung3?
translation: 你下腹有冇痛？

english: Do you have fever or chills?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1 waak6 ze2 faat3 laang5?
translation: 你有冇發燒或者發冷？

english: Is your urine cloudy?
transliteration: Nei5 di1 niu6 jau5 mou5 wan6 zuk6?
translation: 你啲尿有冇混濁？

english: Does your urine have a strong or unusual smell?
transliteration: Nei5 di1 niu6 jau5 mou5 hou2 nung4 waak6 ze2 m4 cam4 soeng4 ge3 hei3 mei6?
translation: 你啲尿有冇好濃或者唔尋常嘅氣味？

english: Have you noticed blood in your urine?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 niu6 jap6 min6 jau5 hyut3?
translation: 你有冇留意到尿入面有血？

english: Is your urine pink, red, or brown?
transliteration: Nei5 di1 niu6 hai6 fan2 hung4 sik1, hung4 sik1, ding6 hai6 fe1 sik1?
translation: 你啲尿係粉紅色、紅色，定係啡色？

english: Have you noticed foam in your urine?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 niu6 jap6 min6 jau5 paau3?
translation: 你有冇留意到尿入面有泡？

english: Have you had a urinary tract infection before?
transliteration: Nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 niu6 dou6 gam2 jim5?
translation: 你以前有冇試過尿道感染？

english: Have you taken antibiotics for this problem?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 gwo3 kong3 sang1 sou3 lai4 ji1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4?
translation: 你有冇食過抗生素嚟醫呢個問題？

english: Is it difficult to start urinating?
transliteration: Nei5 siu2 bin6 si4 wui5 m4 wui5 hou2 naan4 hoi1 ci2?
translation: 你小便時會唔會好難開始？

english: Is your urine stream weaker than before?
transliteration: Nei5 ge3 niu6 lau4 jau5 mou5 bei2 ji5 cin4 joek6?
translation: 你嘅尿流有冇比以前弱？

english: Does your urine stream stop and start?
transliteration: Nei5 ge3 niu6 lau4 wui5 m4 wui5 dyun6 dyun6 zuk6 zuk6?
translation: 你嘅尿流會唔會斷斷續續？

english: Do you have to strain to urinate?
transliteration: Nei5 siu2 bin6 si4 jiu3 m4 jiu3 jung6 lik6?
translation: 你小便時要唔要用力？

english: Do you feel your bladder is not completely empty afterward?
transliteration: Nei5 siu2 bin6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 go3 pong4 gwong1 zung6 mei6 jyun4 cyun4 paai4 hung1?
translation: 你小便完之後，會唔會覺得個膀胱仲未完全排空？

english: Do you dribble urine after finishing?
transliteration: Nei5 siu2 bin6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, wui5 m4 wui5 jau5 niu6 dik1 ceot1 lai4?
translation: 你小便完之後，會唔會有尿滴出嚟？

english: Have you ever been told your prostate is enlarged?
transliteration: Jau5 mou5 ji1 sang1 tung4 nei5 gong2 gwo3 cin4 lit6 sin3 zung2 daai6?
translation: 有冇醫生同你講過前列腺腫大？

english: Have you taken medication for an enlarged prostate?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 gwo3 zi6 liu4 cin4 lit6 sin3 zung2 daai6 ge3 joek6?
translation: 你有冇食過治療前列腺腫大嘅藥？

english: Have you ever been unable to pass urine at all?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jyun4 cyun4 niu6 m4 ceot1?
translation: 你有冇試過完全尿唔出？

english: Do you ever leak urine without meaning to?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 mou4 ji3 zung1 lau6 niu6?
translation: 你有冇試過無意中漏尿？

english: Do you leak urine when coughing, laughing, or lifting?
transliteration: Nei5 kat1, siu3 waak6 ze2 tai4 cung5 mat6 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 lau6 niu6?
translation: 你咳、笑或者提重物嗰陣會唔會漏尿？

english: Do you leak urine on the way to the toilet?
transliteration: Nei5 heoi3 ci3 so2 tou4 zung1 wui5 m4 wui5 lau6 niu6?
translation: 你去廁所途中會唔會漏尿？

english: Do you use pads because of urine leakage?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 jan1 wai6 lau6 niu6 ji4 jung6 wu6 din3?
translation: 你有冇因為漏尿而用護墊？

english: How often does urine leakage happen?
transliteration: Nei5 gei2 noi6 wui5 lau6 jat1 ci3 niu6?
translation: 你幾耐會漏一次尿？

english: Do you feel pressure or a bulge in your pelvic area?
transliteration: Nei5 pun4 gwat1 fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 jau5 aat3 bik1 gam2 waak6 ze2 dat6 hei2?
translation: 你盆骨附近有冇覺得有壓迫感或者凸起？

english: Does urine leakage affect your daily activities?
transliteration: Lau6 niu6 jau5 mou5 jing2 hoeng2 nei5 jat6 soeng4 sang1 wut6?
translation: 漏尿有冇影響你日常生活？

english: Do you have pain in your side or back?
transliteration: Nei5 zak1 bin1 waak6 ze2 bui3 zek3 jau5 mou5 tung3?
translation: 你側邊或者背脊有冇痛？

english: Is the pain on the right side or left side?
transliteration: Tung3 hai6 hai2 zo2 bin1 ding6 jau6 bin1?
translation: 痛係喺左邊定右邊？

english: Does the pain spread toward your groin?
transliteration: Tung3 wui5 m4 wui5 maan6 jin4 dou3 fuk1 gu2 kau1?
translation: 痛會唔會蔓延到腹股溝？

english: Does the pain come in waves?
transliteration: Tung3 wui5 m4 wui5 jat1 zan6 zan6 gam2 lai4?
translation: 痛會唔會一陣陣咁嚟？

english: Is the pain severe enough that you cannot sit still?
transliteration: Tung3 jau5 mou5 jim4 zung6 dou3 ling6 nei5 co5 m4 ding6?
translation: 痛有冇嚴重到令你坐唔定？

english: Do you feel nauseated or have you vomited?
transliteration: Nei5 gok3 dak1 zok3 au2 waak6 ze2 au2 gwo3 mei6?
translation: 你覺得作嘔或者嘔過未？

english: Have you ever had a kidney stone?
transliteration: Nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 san5 sek6?
translation: 你以前有冇腎石？

english: Have you noticed sand or small stones in your urine?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 niu6 jap6 min6 jau5 saa1 waak6 ze2 sai3 sek6?
translation: 你有冇留意到尿入面有沙或者細石？

english: Have you had fever along with this pain?
transliteration: Nei5 tung3 ge3 si4 hau6 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1?
translation: 你痛嘅時候有冇發燒？

english: Have you been told you have kidney disease?
transliteration: Jau5 mou5 ji1 sang1 tung4 nei5 gong2 gwo3 nei5 jau5 san5 beng6?
translation: 有冇醫生同你講過你有腎病？

english: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 tong4 niu6 beng6 waak6 ze2 gou1 hyut3 aat3?
translation: 你有冇糖尿病或者高血壓？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your legs or face?
transliteration: Nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 goek3 waak6 ze2 faai3 min6 zung2?
translation: 你有冇留意到腳或者塊面腫？

english: Have you been drinking less water than usual?
transliteration: Nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jam2 seoi2 jau5 mou5 bei2 ping4 si4 siu2?
translation: 你最近飲水有冇比平時少？

english: How much water do you drink in a day?
transliteration: Nei5 jat1 jat6 jam2 gei2 do1 seoi2?
translation: 你一日飲幾多水？

english: Have you ever needed dialysis?

translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ge3 zing3 zong6 ok3 faa3, cing2 faan1 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1.
translation: 如果你嘅症狀惡化，請返嚟睇醫生。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: do1 ze6 nei5 gam1 jat6 tung4 ngo5 king1 gai2.
translation: 多謝你今日同我傾偈。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: nei5 gam1 jat6 dim2 gaai2 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1?
translation: 你今日點解嚟睇醫生？

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2 jau5 ni1 di1 zing3 zong6?
translation: 你幾時開始有呢啲症狀？

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: nei5 di1 zing3 zong6 jau5 mou5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 jim4 zung6?
translation: 你啲症狀有冇愈嚟愈嚴重？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 zing3 zong6?
translation: 你有冇其他症狀？

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 man6 haa5 nei5 ge3 beng6 lik6?
translation: 我可唔可以問下你嘅病歷？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gim2 caa4 nei5?
translation: 我可唔可以檢查你？

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: nei5 seoi1 m4 seoi1 jiu3 cyun4 jik6 jyun4?
translation: 你需唔需要傳譯員？

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: ji1 sang1 jau5 mou5 can2 dyun3 nei5 jau5 tong4 niu6 beng6?
translation: 醫生有冇診斷你有糖尿病？

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 jat1 jing4 ding6 ji6 jing4 tong4 niu6 beng6?
translation: 你有一型定二型糖尿病？

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 tong4 niu6 beng6 gei2 noi6?
translation: 你有糖尿病幾耐？

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 bei2 ping4 si4 gang3 hau2 hot3?
translation: 你係咪比平時更口渴？

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 siu2 bin6 do1 zo2?
translation: 你係咪小便多咗？

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: nei5 je6 maan5 wui5 m4 wui5 hei2 san1 siu2 bin6?
translation: 你夜晚會唔會起身小便？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 mou5 hak1 ji3 gaam2 fei4 daan6 tai2 cung5 hing1 zo2?
translation: 你有冇冇刻意減肥但體重輕咗？

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 bei2 ping4 si4 gang3 jung4 ji6 tou5 ngo6?
translation: 你係咪比平時更容易肚餓？

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 si6 lik6 mou4 wu4?
translation: 你有冇覺得視力模糊？

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 dak6 bit6 gui6?
translation: 你有冇覺得特別攰？

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 seng4 jat6 gam2 jim5?
translation: 你有冇成日感染？

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: nei5 di1 soeng1 hau2 hai6 mai6 jiu3 hou2 noi6 sin1 zi3 maai4 hau2?
translation: 你啲傷口係咪要好耐先至埋口？

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 hai2 uk1 kei2 jim6 hyut3 tong4?
translation: 你有冇喺屋企驗血糖？

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 noi6 jim6 jat1 ci3 hyut3 tong4?
translation: 你幾耐驗一次血糖？

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: nei5 soeng6 ci3 jim6 dou2 ge3 hyut3 tong4 hai6 gei2 do1?
translation: 你上次驗到嘅血糖係幾多？

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 lin4 zuk6 hyut3 tong4 gaam1 cak1 hei3?
translation: 你有冇用連續血糖監測器？

english: Have you brought your glucose readings?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 daai3 maai4 nei5 ge3 hyut3 tong4 duk6 sou3?
translation: 你有冇帶埋你嘅血糖讀數？

english: Have you had an HbA1c blood test?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jim6 gwo3 HbA1c?
translation: 你有冇驗過 HbA1c？

english: We will check your blood sugar now.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 bong1 nei5 jim6 hyut3 tong4.
translation: 我哋而家幫你驗血糖。

english: Your blood sugar is higher than the target.
transliteration: nei5 ge3 hyut3 tong4 gou1 gwo3 muk6 biu1 seoi2 ping4.
translation: 你嘅血糖高過目標水平。

english: Have you ever had low blood sugar?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 dai1 hyut3 tong4?

english: Do you get shaky or sweaty when your sugar is low?
transliteration: nei5 dai1 hyut3 tong4 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 sau2 zan3 waak6 ze2 ceot1 hon6?
translation: 你低血糖嗰陣會唔會手震或者出汗？

english: Do you feel dizzy or confused when your sugar is low?
transliteration: nei5 dai1 hyut3 tong4 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 tau4 wan4 waak6 ze2 san4 zi3 m4 cing1?
translation: 你低血糖嗰陣會唔會覺得頭暈或者神志唔清？

english: Have you ever fainted because of low blood sugar?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jan1 wai6 dai1 hyut3 tong4 wan4 dai1?
translation: 你有冇試過因為低血糖暈低？

english: What do you do when your blood sugar is low?
transliteration: hyut3 tong4 dai1 go2 zan6, nei5 wui5 dim2 zou6?
translation: 血糖低嗰陣，您會點做？

english: Do you carry something sugary with you?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 ceoi4 san1 daai3 di1 tim4 je5?
translation: 您會唔會隨身帶啲甜嘢？

english: Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 si3 gwo3 hyut3 tong4 hou2 gou1 maa3?
translation: 您最近試過血糖好高嗎？

english: Have you had nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zok3 au2, au2 tou3 waak6 ze2 tou5 tung3?
translation: 您有冇作嘔、嘔吐或者肚痛？

english: Are you breathing faster or deeper than usual?
transliteration: nei5 fu1 kap1 jau5 mou5 bei2 ping4 si4 faai3 zo2 waak6 ze2 sam1 zo2?
translation: 您呼吸有冇比平時快咗或者深咗？

english: Have you ever been hospitalized for diabetic ketoacidosis?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 jan1 wai6 tong4 niu6 beng6 tung4 zing3 syun1 zung1 duk6 zyu6 gwo3 jyun2?
translation: 您以前有冇因為糖尿病酮症酸中毒住過院？

english: What medicines do you take for diabetes?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 gan2 me1 joek6 lai4 hung3 zai3 tong4 niu6 beng6?
translation: 您食緊咩藥嚟控制糖尿病？

english: Do you take diabetes tablets?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 tong4 niu6 beng6 joek6 pin2?
translation: 您有冇食糖尿病藥片？

english: Do you use insulin?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 ji5 dou2 sou3?
translation: 您有冇用胰島素？

english: How many units of insulin do you take?
transliteration: nei5 mui5 ci3 daa2 gei2 do1 go3 daan1 wai6 ji5 dou2 sou3?
translation: 您每次打幾多個單位胰島素？

english: When do you take your insulin?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 si4 daa2 ji5 dou2 sou3?
translation: 您幾時打胰島素？

english: Did you take your insulin today?
transliteration: nei5 gam1 jat6 jau5 mou5 daa2 ji5 dou2 sou3?
translation: 您今日有冇打胰島素？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 lau6 sik6 gwo3 joek6?
translation: 您最近有冇漏食過藥？

english: Do you use an insulin pen or pump?
transliteration: nei5 jung6 ji5 dou2 sou3 bat1 ding6 hai6 ji5 dou2 sou3 bung1?
translation: 您用胰島素筆定係胰島素泵？

english: Where do you inject your insulin?
transliteration: nei5 hai2 bin1 dou6 daa2 ji5 dou2 sou3?
translation: 您喺邊度打胰島素？

english: Do you rotate your injection sites?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 leon4 lau4 hai2 m4 tung4 wai6 zi3 daa2 zam1?
translation: 您會唔會輪流喺唔同位置打針？

english: Have you had side effects from your medicines?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 joek6 jau5 mou5 ceot1 jin6 fu6 zok3 jung6?
translation: 您食藥有冇出現副作用？

english: Would you like me to show you how to inject insulin?
transliteration: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 ngo5 si6 faan6 dim2 joeng6 daa2 ji5 dou2 sou3?
translation: 您想唔想我示範點樣打胰島素？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling in your feet?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 goek3 jau5 mou5 maa4 bai3 waak6 ze2 ci3 tung3 ge3 gam2 gok3?
translation: 您隻腳有冇麻痺或者刺痛嘅感覺？

english: Do you have burning pain in your feet?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 goek3 jau5 mou5 zoek3 jit6 ci3 tung3?
translation: 您隻腳有冇灼熱刺痛？

english: Have you noticed any sores on your feet?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 zek3 goek3 jau5 mou5 syun2 hau2?
translation: 您有冇留意到隻腳有冇損口？

english: Do you check your feet every day?
transliteration: nei5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 gim2 caa4 soeng1 goek3 maa3?
translation: 您每日都會檢查雙腳嗎？

english: Have you had a diabetic eye examination?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 tong4 niu6 beng6 ngaan5 zing1 gim2 caa4?
translation: 您有冇做過糖尿病眼睛檢查？

english: Has diabetes affected your kidneys?
transliteration: tong4 niu6 beng6 jau5 mou5 jing2 hoeng2 nei5 ge3 san5?
translation: 糖尿病有冇影響您嘅腎？

english: Have you had a heart attack or stroke?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 sam1 zong6 beng6 faat3 waak6 ze2 zung3 fung1?
translation: 您有冇試過心臟病發或者中風？

english: I am going to check the feeling in your feet.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 zek3 goek3 ge3 gam2 gok3.
translation: 我而家會檢查您隻腳嘅感覺。

english: Can you feel this on your toes?
transliteration: nei5 goek3 zi2 gam2 gok3 dou3 ni1 dou6 ge3 zuk1 pung3 maa3?
translation: 您腳趾感覺到呢度嘅觸碰嗎？

english: Have you ever had a thyroid problem?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 gaap3 zong6 sin3 jau5 man6 tai4?
translation: 您以前有冇試過甲狀腺有問題？

english: Do you have an underactive thyroid?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gaap3 zong6 sin3 gung1 nang4 dai1 haa6?
translation: 您有冇甲狀腺功能低下？

english: Do you have an overactive thyroid?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gaap3 zong6 sin3 gung1 nang4 kong3 zeon3?
translation: 您有冇甲狀腺功能亢進？

english: Do you feel unusually cold?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 dak6 bit6 paa3 dung3?
translation: 您有冇覺得特別怕凍？

english: Do you feel unusually hot or sweaty?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 dak6 bit6 jit6 waak6 ze2 seng4 jat6 ceot1 hon6?
translation: 您有冇覺得特別熱或者成日出汗？

english: Have you noticed your heart racing?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 sam1 tiu3 dak1 hou2 faai3?
translation: 您有冇覺得心跳得好快？

english: Have you noticed shaking in your hands?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 soeng1 sau2 zan3?
translation: 您有冇留意到雙手震？

english: Have you been constipated?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 bin6 bei3?
translation: 您有冇便秘？

english: Have you been having frequent bowel movements?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 seng4 jat6 daai6 bin6?
translation: 您最近有冇成日大便？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your neck?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 geng2 bou6 zung2 hei2?
translation: 您有冇留意到頸部腫起？

english: Is it difficult to swallow?
transliteration: nei5 tan1 je5 jau5 mou5 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 您吞嘢有冇困難？

english: Has your voice become hoarse?
transliteration: nei5 baa2 seng1 jau5 mou5 bin3 saa1?
translation: 您把聲有冇變沙？

english: Do you take thyroid medication?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 gaap3 zong6 sin3 joek6?
translation: 您有冇食甲狀腺藥？

english: Have you had thyroid surgery or radioactive iodine treatment?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 gaap3 zong6 sin3 sau2 seot6 waak6 ze2 fong3射 sing3 din2 zi6 liu4?
translation: 您有冇做過甲狀腺手術或者放射性碘治療？

english: Has your weight changed recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 tai2 cung5 jau5 mou5 bin3?
translation: 您最近體重有冇變？

english: How much weight have you gained or lost?
transliteration: nei5 zung6 zo2 waak6 ze2 heng1 zo2 gei2 do1?

english: Has your appetite changed?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 wai6 hau2 jau5 mou5 bin3?
translation: 您嘅胃口有冇變？

english: What do you usually eat in a day?
transliteration: nei5 ping4 si4 jat1 jat6 tung1 soeng4 sik6 di1 me1?
translation: 您平時一日通常食啲咩？

english: How often do you exercise?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 noi6 zou6 jat1 ci3 wan6 dung6?
translation: 您幾耐做一次運動？

english: Do you drink sugary drinks?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jam2 tim4 jam2 ban2?
translation: 您有冇飲甜飲品？

english: Have you tried making changes to your diet?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 goi2 bin3 jam2 sik6 zaap6 gwaan3?
translation: 您有冇試過改變飲食習慣？

english: Would you like help with weight management?
transliteration: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jau5 jan4 bong1 nei5 gun2 lei5 tai2 cung5?
translation: 您想唔想有人幫您管理體重？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you ever broken a bone after a minor fall?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 heng1 heng1 dit3 dou2 zau6 zing2 tyun5 gwat1?
translation: 您有冇試過輕輕跌倒就整斷骨？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been told you have osteoporosis?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 jan4 tung4 nei5 gong2 gwo3 nei5 jau5 gwat1 zat1 so1 sung1?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had a bone density scan?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ziu3 gwo3 gwat1 zat1 mat6 dou6?

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you take calcium or vitamin D?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 goi3 pin2 waak6 ze2 wai4 taa1 ming6 di1?
translation: 您有冇食鈣片或者維他命D？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you had kidney stones?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 saang1 gwo3 san5 sek6?
translation: 您有冇生過腎石？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have muscle cramps or spasms?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gei1 juk6 cau1 gan1 waak6 ze2 ging3 lyun4?
translation: 您有冇肌肉抽筋或者痙攣？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Do you have tingling around your mouth or fingers?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi2 bin1 waak6 ze2 sau2 zi2 jau5 mou5 maa4 bai3 waak6 ze2 ci3 tung3?
translation: 您嘴邊或者手指有冇麻痺或者刺痛？

stage: Bone health, calcium and vitamin D
english: Have you been diagnosed with a parathyroid problem?
transliteration: ji1 sang1 jau5 mou5 zan2 dyun3 gwo3 nei5 jau5 fu6 gaap3 zong6 sin3 man6 tai4?
translation: 醫生有冇診斷過您有副甲狀腺問題？

english: Have you ever had a problem with your adrenal glands?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 san5 soeng6 sin3 jau5 man6 tai4?
translation: 您以前有冇試過腎上腺有問題？

english: Do you take steroid medicines such as prednisone?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 leoi6 gu3 cyun4 joek6, lai6 jyu4 prednisone?
translation: 您有冇食類固醇藥，例如 prednisone？

english: How long have you been taking steroids?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 leoi6 gu3 cyun4 sik6 zo2 gei2 noi6?
translation: 您食類固醇食咗幾耐？

english: Have you recently stopped taking steroids?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 ting4 sik6 leoi6 gu3 cyun4?
translation: 您最近有冇停食類固醇？

english: Do you feel dizzy when you stand up?
transliteration: nei5 kei5 hei2 san1 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 tau4 wan4?
translation: 您企起身嗰陣會唔會頭暈？

english: Have you noticed darker patches of skin?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 pei4 fu1 jau5 di1 wai6 zi3 ngaan4 sik1 sam1 zo2?
translation: 您有冇留意到皮膚有啲位置顏色深咗？

english: Do you crave salty foods?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 dak6 bit6 soeng2 sik6 haam4 je5?
translation: 您會唔會特別想食鹹嘢？

english: Have you noticed easy bruising or purple stretch marks?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 jung4 ji6 jyu1 soeng1 waak6 ze2 jau5 zi2 sik1 ge3 jam6 san5 man4?
translation: 您有冇發現自己容易瘀傷或者有紫色嘅妊娠紋？

english: Do you have an emergency steroid plan?

english: Have you had persistent headaches or changes in vision?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ci4 zuk6 tau4 tung3 waak6 ze2 si6 lik6 jau5 bin3?
translation: 您有冇持續頭痛或者視力有變？

english: Have your periods become irregular or stopped?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 jyut6 ging1 jau5 mou5 bin3 dak1 m4 kwai1 leot6, waak6 ze2 ting4 zo2?

english: Have you noticed unexpected milk discharge from your breasts?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 jyu5 fong4 mou4 jyun4 mou4 gu3 lau4 ceot1 naai5?
translation: 您有冇留意到乳房無緣無故流出奶？

english: Have you noticed changes in sexual desire?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 sing3 juk6 jau5 bin3?

english: Have you had problems with erections?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 but6 hei2 kwan3 naan4?

english: Have you noticed increased facial or body hair?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 min6 waak6 ze2 san1 soeng6 ge3 mou4 faat3 do1 zo2?

english: Have you noticed unusual acne or hair loss?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 mou4 gu3 saang1 am3 cong1 waak6 ze2 lat1 tau4 faat3?

english: Have you had difficulty becoming pregnant?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 hou2 naan4 waai4 jan6?

english: Are you taking any hormone treatment?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 gan2 ho4 ji5 mung4 zi6 liu4?
translation: 您有冇用緊荷爾蒙治療？

english: Does anyone in your family have diabetes?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 jan4 jau5 tong4 niu6 beng6?
translation: 您屋企有冇人有糖尿病？

english: Does anyone in your family have thyroid disease?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 jan4 jau5 gaap3 zong6 sin3 beng6?
translation: 您屋企有冇人有甲狀腺病？

english: Do you have high blood pressure or high cholesterol?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gou1 hyut3 aat3 waak6 ze2 gou1 daam2 gu3 cyun4?
translation: 您有冇高血壓或者高膽固醇？

english: Do you have any kidney or heart problems?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 san5 waak6 ze2 sam1 zong6 man6 tai4?
translation: 您有冇腎或者心臟問題？

english: Have you had any surgery?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 sau2 seot6?
translation: 您有冇做過手術？

english: Are you pregnant or planning a pregnancy?
transliteration: nei5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 mou5 waai4 jan6, waak6 ze2 gai3 waak6 waai4 jan6?
translation: 您而家有冇懷孕，或者計劃懷孕？

english: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kap1 jin1 waak6 ze2 jam2 zau2?
translation: 您有冇吸煙或者飲酒？

english: Do you have any medication allergies?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 joek6 mat6 man5 gam2?
translation: 您有冇藥物敏感？

english: I am going to measure your height and weight.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 loeng4 nei5 ge3 san1 gou1 tung4 tai2 cung5.
translation: 我而家會量您嘅身高同體重。

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 loeng4 nei5 ge3 hyut3 aat3.
translation: 我而家會量您嘅血壓。

english: Please hold your hands out in front of you.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 soeng1 sau2 hoeng3 cin4 san1 zik6.
translation: 請您雙手向前伸直。

english: I am checking whether your hands are shaking.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 gim2 caa4 haa5 nei5 soeng1 sau2 jau5 mou5 zan3.
translation: 我而家檢查下您雙手有冇震。

english: Please tilt your head back slightly.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 saau2 wai4 toi4 gou1 siu2 siu2 go3 tau4.
translation: 請您稍為抬高少少個頭。

english: Please swallow while I examine your neck.
transliteration: ngo5 gim2 caa4 nei5 geng2 bou6 go2 zan6, cing2 nei5 tan1 jat1 haa5 hau2 seoi2.
translation: 我檢查您頸部嗰陣，請您吞一下口水。

english: I am going to feel your thyroid gland.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 mo2 haa5 nei5 ge3 gaap3 zong6 sin3.
translation: 我而家會摸下您嘅甲狀腺。

english: Please follow my finger with your eyes.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jung6 ngaan5 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2 juk1.
translation: 請您用眼望住我隻手指郁。

english: I am going to examine your feet for sores.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 zek3 goek3 jau5 mou5 syun2 hau2.
translation: 我而家會檢查您隻腳有冇損口。

english: Please tell me when you feel this touch.
transliteration: nei5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 dim3 dou3 nei5 ge3 si4 hau6, cing2 waa6 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 您覺得我掂到您嘅時候，請話我知。

english: I am going to check your reflexes.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 faan2 se5 faan2 jing3.
translation: 我而家會檢查您嘅反射反應。

english: We need a blood test to check your thyroid hormones.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jim6 hyut3, gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 gaap3 zong6 sin3 ho4 ji5 mung4.
translation: 我哋要驗血，檢查您嘅甲狀腺荷爾蒙。

english: We will check your HbA1c to assess your average blood sugar.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 eit1 bi1 ei1 jat1 si1, tai2 haa5 nei5 ping4 gwan1 hyut3 tong4 gei2 do1.
translation: 我哋會檢查您嘅 HbA1c，睇下您平均血糖幾多。

english: We need to check your kidney function.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 san5 gung1 nang4.
translation: 我哋要檢查您嘅腎功能。

english: We will check your cholesterol.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 daam2 gu3 cyun4.
translation: 我哋會檢查您嘅膽固醇。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 tai4 gung1 niu6 jik6 joeng6 bun2.
translation: 我哋需要您提供尿液樣本。

english: You may need an ultrasound of your thyroid.
transliteration: nei5 ho2 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 ziu3 gaap3 zong6 sin3 ciu1 seng1 bo1.
translation: 您可能需要照甲狀腺超聲波。

english: We may need a bone density scan.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 ziu3 gwat1 zat1 mat6 dou6.
translation: 我哋可能要照骨質密度。

english: Please follow the fasting instructions for this test.
transliteration: cing2 gan1 zyu6 ni1 go3 gim2 caa4 ge3 gam3 sik6 zi2 si6.
translation: 請跟住呢個檢查嘅禁食指示。

english: We will review your medications together.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4 tai2 haa5 nei5 sik6 gan2 ge3 joek6.
translation: 我哋會同你一齊睇吓你食緊嘅藥。

english: Please take this medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: cing2 on3 ziu3 cyu3 fong1 sik6 ni1 zek3 joek6.
translation: 請按照處方食呢隻藥。

english: Do not change your insulin dose without guidance.
transliteration: mei6 dak1 dou2 zi2 dou6 zi1 cin4, m4 hou2 zi6 hang4 goi2 ji1 dou2 sou3 zai1 loeng6.
translation: 未得到指導之前，唔好自行改胰島素劑量。

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: mei6 jau5 ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 zi1 cin4, m4 hou2 dat6 jin4 ting4 sik6 coeng4 kei4 leoi6 gu3 cyun4.
translation: 未有醫生建議之前，唔好突然停食長期類固醇。

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 on1 paai4 gin3 tong4 niu6 beng6 gaau3 juk6 jyun4.
translation: 我哋可以幫你安排見糖尿病教育員。

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: haa6 ci3 cing2 daai3 maai4 nei5 di1 joek6 tung4 hyut3 tong4 duk6 sou3.
translation: 下次請帶埋你啲藥同血糖讀數。

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 jat1 cai4 king1 jat1 go3 sik1 hap6 nei5 ge3 gai3 waak6.
translation: 我哋會一齊傾一個適合你嘅計劃。

english: Are you very drowsy or confused?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 hou2 ngaan5 fan3 waak6 ze2 san4 zi3 wan6 lyun6?
translation: 你有冇好眼瞓或者神志混亂？

english: Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 au2 dou3 jam2 m4 lok6 seoi2?
translation: 你有冇嘔到飲唔落水？

english: Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jim4 zung6 fat6 lik6 waak6 ze2 wan4 dai1?
translation: 你有冇嚴重乏力或者暈低？

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 san4 zi3 wan6 lyun6 waak6 ze2 wan4 dai1, cing2 zik1 hak1 kau4 ji1.
translation: 如果你神志混亂或者暈低，請即刻求醫。

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
transliteration: nei5 haa6 ci3 fuk1 can2 hai6 gei2 si4?
translation: 你下次覆診係幾時？

english: Do you have any questions about the plan?
transliteration: nei5 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6?
translation: 你對呢個計劃有冇問題想問？

english: What would you like help with today?
transliteration: gam1 jat6 jau5 me1 soeng2 ngo5 bong1 nei5?
translation: 今日有咩想我幫你？

english: How have you been feeling lately?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 gok3 dak1 dim2 aa3?
translation: 你最近覺得點呀？

english: Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: ngo5 man6 nei5 gei2 tiu4 si1 jan4 man6 tai4, ho2 ji5 maa3?
translation: 我問你幾條私人問題，可以嗎？

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 di1 man6 tai4 ling6 nei5 m4 syu1 fuk6, nei5 ho2 ji5 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 如果有啲問題令你唔舒服，你可以話畀我知。

english: I will listen without judging you.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 teng1 nei5 gong2, m4 wui5 pai1 ping4 nei5.
translation: 我會聽你講，唔會批評你。

english: Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
transliteration: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 wan2 cyun4 jik6 jyun4 bong1 sau2?
translation: 你想唔想搵傳譯員幫手？

english: I will explain the limits of confidentiality.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 gaai2 sik1 bou2 mat6 ge3 haan6 zi3.
translation: 我會解釋保密嘅限制。

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 me1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 si6 soeng2 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1?
translation: 有冇咩重要嘅事想話畀我知？

english: When did these feelings or symptoms begin?
transliteration: ni1 di1 gam2 gok3 waak6 ze2 zing3 zong6 hai6 gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2 ge3?
translation: 呢啲感覺或者症狀係幾時開始嘅？

english: Did anything happen around the time they started?
transliteration: hoi1 ci2 go2 zan6 cin4 hau6 jau5 mou5 faat3 sang1 gwo3 me1 si6?
translation: 開始嗰陣前後有冇發生過咩事？

english: Have things been getting better or worse?
transliteration: cing4 fong3 jau5 mou5 hou2 zyun2 waak6 ze2 bin3 caa1?
translation: 情況有冇好轉或者變差？

english: How often do you feel this way?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 noi6 wui5 jau5 jat1 ci3 ni1 zung2 gam2 gok3?
translation: 你幾耐會有一次呢種感覺？

english: How much is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 nei5 jat6 soeng4 sang1 wut6 jing2 hoeng2 jau5 gei2 daai6?
translation: 呢件事對你日常生活影響有幾大？

english: Are you able to go to work or school?
transliteration: nei5 zung6 ho2 ji5 faan1 gung1 waak6 ze2 faan1 hok6 maa3?
translation: 你仲可以返工或者返學嗎？

english: Are you managing your usual responsibilities?
transliteration: nei5 zung6 jing1 fu3 dou2 ping4 si4 jiu3 zou6 ge3 si6 maa3?
translation: 你仲應付到平時要做嘅事嗎？

english: What has helped you cope so far?
transliteration: dou3 ji4 gaa1 wai4 zi2, jau5 me1 bong1 dou2 nei5 jing1 fu3 ni1 di1 cing4 fong3?
translation: 到而家為止，有咩幫到你應付呢啲情況？

english: Have you been feeling sad or down?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 soeng1 sam1 waak6 ze2 sam1 cing4 dai1 lok6?
translation: 你最近有冇覺得傷心或者心情低落？

english: Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
transliteration: ji5 cin4 zung1 ji3 zou6 ge3 je5, nei5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 mou5 mou5 hing3 ceoi3?
translation: 以前鍾意做嘅嘢，你而家有冇冇興趣？

english: Do you feel hopeless about the future?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 deoi3 zoeng1 loi4 mou5 hei1 mong6?
translation: 你會唔會覺得對將來冇希望？

english: Do you feel guilty or worthless?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 noi6 gau3 waak6 ze2 zi6 gei2 jat1 mou4 si6 cyu3?
translation: 你會唔會覺得內疚或者自己一無是處？

english: Do you cry more often than usual?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 bei2 ping4 si4 haam3 dak1 do1?
translation: 你有冇比平時喊得多？

english: Has your energy been low?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 hai6 mai6 sing4 jat6 mou5 mat1 zing1 san4?
translation: 你最近係咪成日冇乜精神？

english: Is it hard to concentrate or make decisions?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 hou2 naan4 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4 waak6 ze2 zok3 kyut3 ding6?
translation: 你係咪好難集中精神或者作決定？

english: Have you noticed changes in your appetite?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 wai6 hau2 jau5 bin3?
translation: 你有冇留意到胃口有變？

english: Have you noticed any changes in your weight?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 tai2 zung6 jau5 bin3?
translation: 你有冇留意到體重有變？

english: Do you often feel worried or anxious?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 daam1 sam1 waak6 ze2 ziu1 leoi6?
translation: 你係咪成日覺得擔心或者焦慮？

english: Is it difficult to control your worries?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 hou2 naan4 hung3 zai3 zi6 gei2 ge3 jau1 leoi6?
translation: 你係咪好難控制自己嘅憂慮？

english: Do you feel restless or on edge?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 co5 lap6 bat1 on1 waak6 ze2 sam1 san4 bat1 ding6?
translation: 你會唔會覺得坐立不安或者心神不定？

english: Do you have sudden episodes of intense fear?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 fei1 soeng4 geng1 hung2 ge3 si4 hau6?
translation: 你有冇突然間非常驚恐嘅時候？

english: During these episodes, does your heart race?
transliteration: go2 zan6 si4 nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 sam1 tiu3 dak1 hou2 faai3?
translation: 嗰陣時你會唔會心跳得好快？

english: Do you feel short of breath when anxious?
transliteration: nei5 ziu1 leoi6 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 tau3 m4 dou3 hei3?
translation: 你焦慮嗰陣會唔會覺得透唔到氣？

english: Do you avoid places because you fear having a panic attack?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 jan1 wai6 geng1 hung2 zing3 faat3 zok3 ji4 bei6 hoi1 mau5 di1 dei6 fong1?
translation: 你會唔會因為驚恐症發作而避開某啲地方？

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?
transliteration: jau5 di1 nei5 m4 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 nim6 tau4 wui5 m4 wui5 bat1 ting4 gam3 fau4 jin6?
translation: 有啲你唔想要嘅念頭會唔會不停咁浮現？

english: Do you feel you must repeat certain actions?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 cung4 fuk6 zou6 mau5 di1 dung6 zok3?
translation: 你會唔會覺得一定要重複做某啲動作？

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: nei5 mui5 maan5 fan3 gei2 do1 go3 zung1?
translation: 你每晚瞓幾多個鐘？

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 hou2 naan4 jap6 seoi6?
translation: 你係咪好難入睡？

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: nei5 je6 maan5 wui5 m4 wui5 sing4 jat6 seng2?
translation: 你夜晚會唔會成日醒？

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 zou2 gwo3 zi6 gei2 soeng2 hei2 san1 ge3 si4 gaan3 seng2?
translation: 你會唔會早過自己想起身嘅時間醒？

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: nei5 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1 gok3 dak1 zing1 san4 maa3?
translation: 你朝早起身覺得精神嗎？

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 ok3 mung6?
translation: 你有冇發惡夢？

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 fan3 dak1 bei2 ping4 si4 do1 hou2 do1?
translation: 你最近有冇瞓得比平時多好多？

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: nei5 jat6 tau4 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 gui6?
translation: 你日頭會唔會覺得攰？

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jau5 dyun6 si4 gaan3 gok3 dak1 dak6 bit6 jau5 zing1 lik6 waak6 ze2 hou2 hing1 fan5?
translation: 你有冇試過有段時間覺得特別有精力或者好興奮？

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 fan3 siu2 hou2 do1 daan6 jau6 m4 gok3 dak1 gui6?
translation: 你有冇試過瞓少好多但又唔覺得攰？

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 jan4 waa6 gwo3 nei5 gong2 je5 faai3 dak1 m4 cam4 soeng4?
translation: 有冇人話過你講嘢快得唔尋常？

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 go3 nou5 jap6 min6 di1 nam2 faat3 zyun2 dak1 hou2 faai3?
translation: 你有冇覺得個腦入面啲諗法轉得好快？

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 dak6 bit6 jau5 seon3 sam1 waak6 ze2 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6?
translation: 你有冇覺得自己特別有信心或者好有能力？

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sai2 do1 zo2 cin2, ciu1 ceot1 zi6 gei2 jyun4 bun2 daa2 syun3?
translation: 你有冇使多咗錢，超出自己原本打算？

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: ni1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 ping4 si4 m4 wui5 zou6 ge3 mou6 him2 hang4 wai4?
translation: 呢段時間你有冇做過平時唔會做嘅冒險行為？

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: ni1 di1 si4 kei4 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 noi6?
translation: 呢啲時期持續咗幾耐？

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 dou2 kei4 taa1 jan4 teng1 m4 dou2 ge3 sing1 jam1?
translation: 你有冇聽到其他人聽唔到嘅聲音？

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gin3 dou2 kei4 taa1 jan4 tai2 m4 dou2 ge3 je5?
translation: 你有冇見到其他人睇唔到嘅嘢？

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 jau5 jan4 gaam1 si6 waak6 ze2 gan1 zung1 nei5?
translation: 你會唔會覺得有人監視或者跟蹤你？

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 jau5 jan4 soeng2 soeng1 hoi6 nei5?
translation: 你會唔會覺得有人想傷害你？

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 ge3 si1 soeng2 sau6 dou3 hung3 zai3?
translation: 你會唔會覺得自己嘅思想受到控制？

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: di1 sing1 jam1 jau5 mou5 giu3 nei5 zou6 di1 je5?
translation: 啲聲音有冇叫你做啲嘢？

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: nei5 gok3 dak1 ni1 di1 ging1 lik6 doi6 biu2 di1 me1?
translation: 你覺得呢啲經歷代表啲咩？

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: ni1 di1 ging1 lik6 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 geng1?
translation: 呢啲經歷會唔會令你驚？

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: jau5 si4 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 naan4 ngaai4, wui5 nam2 dou3 sei2 mong4. nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 gam2 nam2?
translation: 有時人覺得好難捱，會諗到死亡。你有冇試過咁諗？

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 hei1 mong6 zi6 gei2 fan3 zo2 zi1 hau6 m4 sai2 zoi3 seng2?
translation: 你有冇希望自己瞓咗之後唔使再醒？

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 nam2 gwo3 git3 cuk1 zi6 gei2 ge3 sang1 ming6?
translation: 你有冇諗過結束自己嘅生命？

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: nei5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 mou5 ni1 di1 nim6 tau4?
translation: 你而家有冇呢啲念頭？

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 nam2 gwo3 wui5 jung6 me1 fong1 faat3 heoi3 zou6?
translation: 你有冇諗過會用咩方法去做？

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gai3 waak6 git3 cuk1 zi6 gei2 ge3 sang1 ming6?
translation: 你有冇計劃結束自己嘅生命？

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zip3 cuk1 dou2 jam6 ho4 ho2 nang4 jung6 lai4 soeng1 hoi6 zi6 gei2 ge3 je5?
translation: 你有冇接觸到任何可能用嚟傷害自己嘅嘢？

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 git3 cuk1 zi6 gei2 ge3 sang1 ming6?
translation: 你以前有冇試過結束自己嘅生命？

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 gu3 ji3 soeng1 hoi6 gwo3 zi6 gei2?
translation: 你以前有冇故意傷害過自己？

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: dou3 ji4 gaa1 wai4 zi2, jau5 me1 bong1 dou2 nei5 kok3 bou2 zi6 gei2 on1 cyun4?
translation: 到而家為止，有咩幫到你確保自己安全？

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 nei5 seon3 dak1 gwo3 ge3 jan4, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 lyun4 lok6?
translation: 有冇你信得過嘅人，我哋可以聯絡？

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: ngo5 daam1 sam1 nei5 ge3 on1 cyun4, soeng2 bong1 nei5 kok3 bou2 on1 cyun4.
translation: 我擔心你嘅安全，想幫你確保安全。

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: nei5 hai2 zyu6 ge3 dei6 fong1 gok3 dak1 on1 cyun4 maa3?
translation: 你喺住嘅地方覺得安全嗎？

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 jan4 wai1 hip3 gwo3 nei5 waak6 ze2 soeng1 hoi6 gwo3 nei5?
translation: 有冇人威脅過你或者傷害過你？

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: nei5 hai2 uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 geng1 bin1 go3?
translation: 你喺屋企有冇驚邊個？

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 nam2 gwo3 soeng1 hoi6 kei4 taa1 jan4?
translation: 你有冇諗過傷害其他人？

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 nam2 zyu6 soeng1 hoi6 mau5 jat1 go3 jan4?
translation: 你有冇諗住傷害某一個人？

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gai3 waak6 soeng1 hoi6 jam6 ho4 jan4?
translation: 你有冇計劃傷害任何人？

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 siu2 pang4 jau5 waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 seoi1 jiu3 dak6 bit6 ziu3 gu3 ge3 jan4?
translation: 屋企有冇小朋友或者其他需要特別照顧嘅人？

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ging1 lik6 gwo3 jat1 di1 ling6 jan4 geng1 fong1 waak6 ze2 cong1 soeng1 ge3 si6?
translation: 你有冇經歷過一啲令人驚慌或者創傷嘅事？

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: nei5 mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 zi1 cin4, m4 sai2 gong2 coeng4 cing4.
translation: 你未準備好之前，唔使講詳情。

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: go2 gin6 si6 ge3 gei3 jik1 wui5 m4 wui5 dat6 jin4 faan1 faan1 lai4?
translation: 嗰件事嘅記憶會唔會突然返返嚟？

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 gwo3 gwaan1 jyu1 go2 gin6 si6 ge3 ok3 mung6?
translation: 你有冇發過關於嗰件事嘅惡夢？

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 bei6 hoi1 ling6 nei5 nam2 hei2 go2 gin6 si6 ge3 jan4 waak6 ze2 si6?
translation: 你會唔會避開令你諗起嗰件事嘅人或事？

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 sing4 jat6 tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3, waak6 ze2 gok3 dak1 m4 on1 cyun4?
translation: 你會唔會成日提高警覺，或者覺得唔安全？

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 si4 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 tung4 zi6 gei2 waak6 ze2 zau1 wai4 ge3 waan4 ging2 hou2 ci5 tyut3 zo2 zit3?
translation: 你有時會唔會覺得同自己或者周圍嘅環境好似脫咗節？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jam2 zau2?
translation: 你有冇飲酒？

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 noi6 jam2 jat1 ci3 zau2? mui5 ci3 jam2 gei2 do1?
translation: 你幾耐飲一次酒？每次飲幾多？

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 nam2 gwo3 siu2 jam2 di1 zau2?
translation: 你有冇諗過少飲啲酒？

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 jan4 tung4 nei5 gong2 gwo3, daam1 sam1 nei5 jam2 zau2?
translation: 有冇人同你講過，擔心你飲酒？

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kap1 sik6 daai6 maa4?
translation: 你有冇吸食大麻？

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 ho2 kaa1 jan1, aa1 pin3 leoi6 joek6 mat6, waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 duk6 ban2?
translation: 你有冇用可卡因、鴉片類藥物，或者其他毒品？

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jung6 zam1 daa2 duk6 ban2?
translation: 你有冇試過用針打毒品？

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: nei5 soeng6 jat1 ci3 jam2 zau2 waak6 ze2 jung6 kei4 taa1 joek6 mat6 hai6 gei2 si4?
translation: 你上一次飲酒或者用其他藥物係幾時？

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: nei5 ting4 jung6 go2 di1 je5 zi1 hau6, wui5 m4 wui5 sau2 zan3 waak6 ze2 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6?
translation: 你停用嗰啲嘢之後，會唔會手震或者覺得唔舒服？

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 ting4 jung6 zi1 hau6 din1 gaan2 faat3 zok3?
translation: 你有冇試過停用之後癲癇發作？

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jau5 jan4 bong1 nei5 gaam2 siu2 waak6 ze2 ting4 zi2 jung6 joek6 mat6?
translation: 你想唔想有人幫你減少或者停止用藥物？

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: nei5 dim2 tai2 zi6 gei2 ge3 jam2 sik6 zaap6 gwaan3?
translation: 你點睇自己嘅飲食習慣？

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 seng4 jat6 daam1 sam1 zi6 gei2 ge3 tai2 zung6 waak6 ze2 san1 jing4?
translation: 你會唔會成日擔心自己嘅體重或者身形？

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 m4 sik6 zing3 caan1, waak6 ze2 hak1 ji3 siu2 sik6 je5?
translation: 你最近有冇唔食正餐，或者刻意少食嘢？

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 sik6 je5 ting4 m4 dou2?
translation: 你有冇試過覺得自己食嘢停唔到？

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 sik6 jyun4 je5 zi1 hau6 zi6 gei2 ceoi1 tou3?
translation: 你有冇試過食完嘢之後自己催吐？

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 wai6 zo2 dai2 siu1 sik6 je5 ji4 zou6 wan6 dung6?
translation: 你有冇為咗抵消食嘢而做運動？

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 hou2 naan4 zaap6 zung1 zing1 san4?
translation: 你有冇試過好難集中精神？

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 joek3 wui6 waak6 ze2 jiu3 zou6 ge3 si6?
translation: 你係咪成日唔記得約會或者要做嘅事？

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 zi6 gei2 ge3 gei3 jik1 jau5 bin3 faa3?
translation: 你有冇留意到自己嘅記憶有變化？

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: nei5 gok3 dak1 on1 paai4 si6 cing4 hou2 kwan3 naan4 maa3?
translation: 你覺得安排事情好困難嗎？

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 hou2 wan6 lyun6?
translation: 你最近有冇覺得好混亂？

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 jan4 lau4 ji3 dou3 nei5 ge3 hang4 wai4 jau5 bin3 faa3?
translation: 有冇人留意到你嘅行為有變化？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 nei5 ge3 cyun4 ming4?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知你嘅全名？

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 gam1 jat6 hai6 gei2 jyut6 gei2 hou6?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知今日係幾月幾號？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 hai2 bin1 dou6?
translation: 你可唔可以話畀我知我哋而家喺邊度？

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 gong2 saam1 go3 zi6, cing2 nei5 gan1 zyu6 gong2 jat1 ci3.
translation: 我會講三個字，請你跟住講一次。

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 si3 haa5 gei3 zyu6 go2 gei2 go3 zi6, ci4 di1 ngo5 wui5 zoi3 man6 nei5.
translation: 請你試下記住嗰幾個字，遲啲我會再問你。

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: nei5 ji4 gaa1 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 faan1 go2 saam1 go3 zi6 bei2 ngo5 teng1?
translation: 你而家可唔可以講返嗰三個字畀我聽？

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 jat1 go3 zi6 dou3 zyun2 cyun3 ceot1 lai4?
translation: 你可唔可以將一個字倒轉串出嚟？

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: nei5 gok3 dak1 ni1 di1 kwan3 naan4 hai6 me1 jan1 jan4 zou6 sing4 ge3?
translation: 你覺得呢啲困難係咩原因造成嘅？

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: nei5 gam1 jat6 ge3 sam1 cing4 dim2 joeng6?
translation: 你今日嘅心情點樣？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 gin3 gwo3 zing1 san4 fo1 ji1 sang1 waak6 ze2 fu6 dou6 jyun4?
translation: 你以前有冇見過精神科醫生或者輔導員？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 jan1 wai6 zing1 san4 gin6 hong1 man6 tai4 jap6 gwo3 jyun2?
translation: 你以前有冇因為精神健康問題入過院？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jan4 jau5 mou5 jan4 jau5 gwo3 zing1 san4 gin6 hong1 fong1 min6 ge3 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 你屋企人有冇人有過精神健康方面嘅困難？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jam6 ho4 gin6 hong1 man6 tai4?
translation: 你有冇任何健康問題？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: nei5 tung4 bin1 go3 jat1 cai4 zyu6?
translation: 你同邊個一齊住？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 me1 jan4 ho2 ji5 wan2 lai4 bong1 sau2?
translation: 你有咩人可以搵嚟幫手？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 ging1 zai3 waak6 ze2 zyu6 uk1 fong1 min6 ge3 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 你最近有冇經濟或者住屋方面嘅困難？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 jan4 zai3 gwaan1 hai6 jau5 mou5 ling6 nei5 gok3 dak1 jau5 aat3 lik6?
translation: 你嘅人際關係有冇令你覺得有壓力？

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: nei5 ji4 gaa1 sik6 gan2 di1 me1 joek6?
translation: 你而家食緊啲咩藥？

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 kong3 jat1 wat1 joek6?
translation: 你有冇食抗抑鬱藥？

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 zi6 liu4 ziu1 leoi6 ge3 joek6?
translation: 你有冇食治療焦慮嘅藥？

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 kong3 zing1 san4 beng6 joek6?
translation: 你有冇食抗精神病藥？

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 cing4 seoi5 wan2 ding6 zai1?
translation: 你有冇食情緒穩定劑？

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 on1 min4 joek6 waak6 ze2 ban2 ji6 daam6 zoek3 leoi6 joek6 mat6?
translation: 你有冇食安眠藥或者苯二氮䓬類藥物？

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: nei5 mui5 ci3 sik6 gei2 do1 zai1 loeng6? gei2 noi6 sik6 jat1 ci3?
translation: 你每次食幾多劑量？幾耐食一次？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 ni1 zek3 joek6 sik6 zo2 gei2 noi6?
translation: 你食呢隻藥食咗幾耐？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 lau6 sik6 gwo3 joek6?
translation: 你最近有冇漏食過藥？

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: ni1 zek3 joek6 jau5 mou5 bong1 dou3 nei5?
translation: 呢隻藥有冇幫到你？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 jam6 ho4 fu6 zok3 jung6?
translation: 你有冇留意到任何副作用？

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 ting4 gwo3 jam6 ho4 joek6?
translation: 你最近有冇停過任何藥？

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: nei5 hei1 mong6 zi6 liu4 ho2 ji5 daat6 dou3 me1 muk6 biu1?
translation: 你希望治療可以達到咩目標？

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 hing3 ceoi3 zou6 sam1 lei5 zi6 liu4 waak6 ze2 fu6 dou6?
translation: 你有冇興趣做心理治療或者輔導？

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 king1 haa5 jau5 me1 joek6 mat6 syun2 zaak6.
translation: 我哋可以一齊傾下有咩藥物選擇。

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: jau5 di1 joek6 jiu3 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 wui5 jyun4 cyun4 gin3 haau6.
translation: 有啲藥要幾個星期先會完全見效。

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: ting4 joek6 zi1 cin4, cing2 sin1 tung4 nei5 ge3 ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 king1 haa5.
translation: 停藥之前，請先同你嘅醫護人員傾下。

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 ngo5 dei6 wan2 jat1 wai2 nei5 seon3 jam6 ge3 gaa1 jan4 jat1 cai4 bong1 sau2?
translation: 你想唔想我哋搵一位你信任嘅家人一齊幫手？

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 zing3 zong6 ok3 faa3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 gai3 waak6 dim2 joeng6 jing3 deoi3.
translation: 如果症狀惡化，我哋可以一齊計劃點樣應對。

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: nei5 deoi3 zi6 liu4 jau5 me1 daam1 sam1?
translation: 你對治療有咩擔心？

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: nei5 gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 faan1 uk1 kei2 on1 cyun4 maa3?
translation: 你覺得今日返屋企安全嗎？

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 m4 on1 cyun4, ho2 ji5 daa2 bei2 bin1 go3?
translation: 如果你覺得唔安全，可以打畀邊個？

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 jing6 cing1 co2, me1 cing4 fong3 doi6 biu2 si6 cing4 hoi1 ci2 bin3 caa1?
translation: 我哋可唔可以一齊認清楚，咩情況代表事情開始變差？

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zik1 si4 san1 cyu5 ngai4 him2, cing2 cam4 kau4 gan2 kap1 hip3 zo6.
translation: 如果你即時身處危險，請尋求緊急協助。

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 on1 paai4 fuk1 can2.
translation: 我哋可以幫你安排覆診。

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jiu3 bun2 dei6 zi1 jyun4 fuk6 mou6 ge3 zi1 liu2?
translation: 你想唔想要本地支援服務嘅資料？

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: nei5 zung6 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 je5 soeng2 man6?
translation: 你仲有冇其他嘢想問？

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 soeng2 man6 nei5 gei2 tiu4 gwaan1 jyu1 zing3 zong6 ge3 man6 tai4.
translation: 我而家想問你幾條關於症狀嘅問題。

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 co1 gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2 jau5 ni1 di1 zing3 zong6?
translation: 你最初幾時開始有呢啲症狀？

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: ni1 di1 zing3 zong6 hai6 dat6 jin4 hoi1 ci2, ding6 hai6 maan6 maan6 ceot1 jin6?
translation: 呢啲症狀係突然開始，定係慢慢出現？

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: hoi1 ci2 go2 zan6 nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 gan2 me1?
translation: 開始嗰陣你喺度做緊咩？

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: ni1 di1 zing3 zong6 hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5, ding6 hai6 si4 jau5 si4 mou4?
translation: 呢啲症狀係一直都有，定係時有時無？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mui5 ci3 faat3 zok3 wui5 ci4 zuk6 gei2 noi6?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: ni1 zung2 cing4 fong3 jat1 jat6 waak6 ze2 jat1 sing1 kei4 wui5 faat3 sang1 gei2 do1 ci3?
translation: 呢種情況一日或者一星期會發生幾多次？

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 zing3 zong6 jau5 mou5 hou2 zyun2, ok3 faa3, waak6 ze2 mou5 bin3?
translation: 你嘅症狀有冇好轉、惡化，或者冇變？

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jau5 ni1 go3 man6 tai4?
translation: 你以前有冇試過有呢個問題？

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 di1 me1 wui5 ling6 cing4 fong3 hou2 di1 waak6 ze2 caa1 di1?
translation: 有冇啲咩會令情況好啲或者差啲？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: gim2 caa4 kei4 gaan3 jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6, cing2 zik1 hak1 waa6 bei2 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 檢查期間如果你覺得唔舒服，請即刻話畀我知。

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 gok3 dak1 san1 tai2 jat1 bin1 mou5 lik6?
translation: 你有冇突然覺得身體一邊冇力？

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 gok3 dak1 bun3 bin1 min6 dap1 zo2 lok6 lai4?
translation: 你有冇突然覺得半邊面耷咗落嚟？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 gong2 je5 jau5 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 你有冇突然講嘢有困難？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 teng1 m4 ming4 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5?
translation: 你有冇突然聽唔明人哋講嘢？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 jat1 zek3 ngaan5 waak6 ze2 loeng5 zek3 ngaan5 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2?
translation: 你有冇突然一隻眼或者兩隻眼都睇唔到？

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 sat1 heoi3 ping4 hang4 waak6 ze2 sau2 goek3 m4 hip3 tiu4?
translation: 你有冇突然失去平衡或者手腳唔協調？

english: What time were you last completely well?
transliteration: nei5 soeng6 jat1 ci3 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 si6 hai6 gei2 dim2?
translation: 你上一次完全冇事係幾點？

english: Did the symptoms go away completely?
transliteration: di1 zing3 zong6 jau5 mou5 jyun4 cyun4 siu1 sat1?
translation: 啲症狀有冇完全消失？

english: Did you have the worst headache of your life?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 tau4 tung3 dak1 hai6 jat1 sang1 jan4 zeoi3 jim4 zung6?
translation: 你有冇試過頭痛得係一生人最嚴重？

english: Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: tau4 tung3 jau5 mou5 hai2 gei2 miu5 waak6 ze2 jat1 fan1 zung1 noi6 tung3 dou3 zeoi3 ging6?
translation: 頭痛有冇喺幾秒或者一分鐘內痛到最勁？

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1 tung4 geng2 gang2?
translation: 你有冇發燒同頸梗？

english: Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 sau2 ci3 din1 gaan2 faat3 zok3 waak6 ze2 sat1 heoi3 zi1 gok3?
translation: 你最近有冇首次癲癇發作或者失去知覺？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 naan4 ji5 hung3 zai3 siu2 bin6 waak6 ze2 daai6 bin6?
translation: 你最近有冇突然難以控制小便或者大便？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: nei5 syu2 hai1 waak6 ze2 tyun4 bou6 zau1 wai4 jau5 mou5 maa4 bei3?
translation: 你鼠蹊或者臀部周圍有冇麻痺？

english: Where exactly is your headache?
transliteration: nei5 tau4 tung3 ge3 kok3 cit3 wai6 zi3 hai2 bin1 dou6?
translation: 你頭痛嘅確切位置喺邊度？

english: Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: nei5 tau4 ge3 jat1 bin1 tung3, ding6 hai6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 tung3?
translation: 你頭嘅一邊痛，定係兩邊都痛？

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: tung3 cyu2 jau5 mou5 maan6 jin4 dou3 geng2, min6, waak6 ze2 ngaan5 wo1 hau6 min6?
translation: 痛楚有冇蔓延到頸、面，或者眼窩後面？

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: tung3 cyu2 hai6 jat1 tiu3 jat1 tiu3, aat3 zyu6, ci3 tung3, ding6 hai6 zoek3 tung3?
translation: 痛楚係一跳一跳、壓住、刺痛，定係灼痛？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 ling4 fan1 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung3, sap6 fan1 hai6 zeoi3 tung3, nei5 ge3 tung3 jau5 gei2 tung3?
translation: 如果零分係完全唔痛，十分係最痛，你嘅痛有幾痛？

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: tau4 tung3 go2 zan6, gwong1 waak6 ze2 sing1 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6?
translation: 頭痛嗰陣，光或者聲會唔會令你覺得唔舒服？

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
transliteration: tau4 tung3 go2 zan6, nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 zok3 au2 waak6 ze2 au2 tou3?
translation: 頭痛嗰陣，你會唔會覺得作嘔或者嘔吐？

english: Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: tau4 tung3 zi1 cin4, nei5 jau5 mou5 gin3 dou3 sim2 gwong1 waak6 ze2 geoi3 ci2 jing4 ge3 sin3?
translation: 頭痛之前，你有冇見到閃光或者鋸齒形嘅線？

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
transliteration: zou6 wan6 dung6 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 tau4 tung3 gaa1 kek6?
translation: 做運動會唔會令頭痛加劇？

english: Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: kat1, jung6 lik6, waak6 ze2 waan1 dai1 san1, wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 go3 tau4 tung3 dak1 gang3 sai1 lei6?
translation: 咳、用力，或者彎低身，會唔會令個頭痛得更犀利？

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: fan3 dai1 waak6 ze2 kei5 hei2 san1 go2 zan6, tau4 tung3 wui5 m4 wui5 gang3 sai1 lei6?
translation: 瞓低或者企起身嗰陣，頭痛會唔會更犀利？

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
transliteration: tau4 tung3 jau5 mou5 tung3 seng2 nei5?
translation: 頭痛有冇痛醒你？

english: Have your headaches changed recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 di1 tau4 tung3 jau5 mou5 bin3 faa3?
translation: 你最近啲頭痛有冇變化？

english: How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: nei5 mui5 go3 jyut6 jau5 gei2 do1 jat6 wui5 tau4 tung3?
translation: 你每個月有幾多日會頭痛？

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 noi6 sik6 jat1 ci3 zi2 tung3 joek6 lai4 ji1 tau4 tung3?
translation: 你幾耐食一次止痛藥嚟醫頭痛？

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 sing4 go3 fong2 hai2 dou6 zyun3, waak6 ze2 gok3 dak1 wan4 dai1?
translation: 你會唔會覺得成個房喺度轉，或者覺得暈低？

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
transliteration: nei5 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 kei5 m4 wan2?
translation: 你行路嗰陣會唔會覺得企唔穩？

english: Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: zyun2 tau4 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 tau4 wan4?
translation: 轉頭會唔會令你頭暈？

english: Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: kei5 hei2 san1 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 tau4 wan4?
translation: 企起身會唔會令你頭暈？

english: Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: tau4 wan4 wui5 ci4 zuk6 gei2 noi6? gei2 miu5, gei2 fan1 zung1, gei2 go3 zung1, ding6 hai6 gang3 noi6?
translation: 頭暈會持續幾耐？幾秒、幾分鐘、幾個鐘，定係更耐？

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 zai2 jau5 mou5 ung1 ung1 seng1, waak6 ze2 ting1 lik6 jau5 mou5 bin3 caa1?
translation: 你耳仔有冇嗡嗡聲，或者聽力有冇變差？

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jan1 wai6 tau4 wan4 dit3 dai1?
translation: 你有冇試過因為頭暈跌低？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: nei5 zi6 gei2 haang4 lou6 dak1 m4 dak1, m4 sai2 jan4 fu4?
translation: 你自己行路得唔得，唔使人扶？

english: Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 sau2 waak6 ze2 zek3 goek3 gok3 m4 gok3 dak1 mou5 lik6?
translation: 你隻手或者隻腳覺唔覺得冇力？

english: Is one side weaker than the other?
transliteration: jat1 bin1 hai6 mai6 bei2 ling6 jat1 bin1 mou5 lik6?
translation: 一邊係咪比另一邊冇力？

english: Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kwan3 naan4 zoeng3 soeng1 sau2 geoi2 gwo3 tau4 deng2?
translation: 你有冇困難將雙手舉過頭頂？

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kwan3 naan4 jau4 zoeng1 ji2 dou6 kei5 hei2 san1?
translation: 你有冇困難由張椅度企起身？

english: Do you trip because your foot drags?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 jan1 wai6 zek3 goek3 to1 zyu6 haang4 ji4 baan6 can1?
translation: 你會唔會因為隻腳拖住行而絆親？

english: Do you drop objects from your hands?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 seng4 jat6 ling1 m4 wan2 je5, di1 je5 dit3 lok6 dei6?
translation: 你會唔會成日拎唔穩嘢，啲嘢跌落地？

english: Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: cung4 fuk1 zou6 je5 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 mou5 lik6 ge3 cing4-fong3 gang3 caa1?
translation: 重複做嘢會唔會令冇力嘅情況更差？

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
transliteration: jau1 sik1 zi1 hau6, mou5 lik6 ge3 cing4-fong3 wui5 m4 wui5 hou2 di1?
translation: 休息之後，冇力嘅情況會唔會好啲？

english: Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 gei1 juk6 tiu3, waak6 ze2 cau1 gan1?
translation: 你有冇留意到肌肉跳，或者抽筋？

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 di1 gei1 juk6 maan6 maan6 bin3 sai3?
translation: 你有冇覺得啲肌肉慢慢變細？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: nei5 san1 tai2 jau5 mou5 bin1 dou6 maa4 bei3 waak6 ze2 ci3 ci3 dei2?
translation: 你身體有冇邊度麻痺或者刺刺哋？

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: maa4 bei3 hai6 jau4 bin1 dou6 hoi1 ci2, jau6 wui5 kwok3 saan3 heoi3 bin1 dou6?
translation: 麻痺係由邊度開始，又會擴散去邊度？

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 loeng5 zek3 sau2 waak6 ze2 loeng5 zek3 goek3 dou1 maa4 bei3?
translation: 你係咪兩隻手或者兩隻腳都麻痺？

english: Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zoek3 jit6 waak6 ze2 hou2 ci5 zuk1 din6 gam3 ge3 tung3?
translation: 你有冇灼熱或者好似觸電咁嘅痛？

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
transliteration: di1 tung3 wui5 m4 wui5 jau4 bui3 zek3 jat1 lou6 lok6 dou3 zek3 goek3?
translation: 啲痛會唔會由背脊一路落到隻腳？

english: Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: nei5 ping4 si4 fan1 m4 fan1 dou2 jit6 tung4 dung3?
translation: 你平時分唔分到熱同凍？

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: dim3 dou2 pei4 fu1 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 gok3 dak1 ji6 soeng4 gam3 tung3?
translation: 掂到皮膚會唔會令你覺得異常咁痛？

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 din1 haan4 faat3 zok3 waak6 ze2 cau1 gan1?
translation: 你以前有冇試過癲癇發作或者抽筋？

english: Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: faat3 zok3 go2 zan6, jau5 mou5 jan4 gin3 dou2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6?
translation: 發作嗰陣，有冇人見到發生咩事？

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 sau2 waak6 ze2 zek3 goek3 jau5 mou5 hung3 zai3 m4 dou2 gam3 zan3?
translation: 你隻手或者隻腳有冇控制唔到咁震？

english: Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
transliteration: nei5 go2 zan6 jau5 mou5 m4 zi1 dou6 san1 bin1 faat3 sang1 gan2 me1 si6?
translation: 你嗰陣有冇唔知道身邊發生緊咩事？

english: Did you bite your tongue?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ngaau5 can1 tiu4 lei6?
translation: 你有冇咬親條脷？

english: Did you lose control of your bladder?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sat1 gam3, hung3 zai3 m4 dou2 siu2 bin6?
translation: 你有冇失禁，控制唔到小便？

english: Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
transliteration: zi1 hau6 nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 mai4 mai4 wu4 wu4, waak6 ze2 hou2 ngaan5 fan3?
translation: 之後你有冇覺得迷迷糊糊，或者好眼瞓？

english: Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: faat3 zok3 zi1 cin4, nei5 jau5 mou5 man4 dou2 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 hei3 mei6, gok3 dak1 kei4 gwaai3, waak6 ze2 jau5 di1 jyu6 ziu6?
translation: 發作之前，你有冇聞到奇怪嘅氣味、覺得奇怪，或者有啲預兆？

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: nei5 gwo3 zo2 gei2 noi6 sin1 zi3 fui1 fuk6 zing3 soeng4?
translation: 你過咗幾耐先至恢復正常？

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau6 sik6 gwo3 din1 haan4 joek6?
translation: 你有冇漏食過癲癇藥？

english: Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: nei5 deoi3 sau2 hai2 jau1 sik1 go2 zan6, waak6 ze2 jung6 gan2 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 zan3?
translation: 你對手喺休息嗰陣，或者用緊嗰陣會唔會震？

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: zan3 hai6 jing2 hoeng2 jat1 zek3 sau2 ding6 loeng5 zek3 sau2?
translation: 震係影響一隻手定兩隻手？

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
transliteration: nei5 se2 zi6 jau5 mou5 bin3 dak1 sai3 zo2?
translation: 你寫字有冇變得細咗？

english: Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 san1 tai2 goeng1 ngaang6, waak6 ze2 juk1 dak1 maan6 zo2?
translation: 你有冇覺得身體僵硬，或者郁得慢咗？

english: Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 hei2 bou6 haang4 lou6 jau5 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 你有冇試過起步行路有困難？

english: Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
