transliteration: nei5 haang4 lou6 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 dat6 jin4 haang4 m4 juk1, hou2 ci5 kaa1 zyu6 gam3?
translation: 你行路嗰陣會唔會突然行唔郁，好似卡住咁？

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 seng1 sin3 waak6 ze2 min6 bou6 biu2 cing4 jau5 bin3?
translation: 你有冇留意到聲線或者面部表情有變？

english: Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 zeoi3 gan6 king1 gwo3 ge3 gai2, waak6 ze2 joek3 hou2 zo2 ge3 si6?
translation: 你有冇成日唔記得最近傾過嘅偈，或者約好咗嘅事？

english: Do you have trouble finding the right words?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 wan2 m4 dou2 ngaam1 ge3 zi6 ngaan5?
translation: 你有冇試過搵唔到啱嘅字眼？

english: Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 hai2 suk6 sik1 ge3 dei6 fong1 mai4 lou6?
translation: 你有冇喺熟悉嘅地方迷路？

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kwan3 naan4 gun2 lei5 joek6 mat6 waak6 ze2 coi4 mou6?
translation: 你有冇困難管理藥物或者財務？

english: Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 cing4 seoi5 waak6 ze2 hang4 wai4 jau5 bin3?
translation: 你有冇留意到情緒或者行為有變？

english: Do you have trouble concentrating?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zaap6 zung1 m4 dou2 zing1 san4?
translation: 你有冇集中唔到精神？

english: Has your speech become slurred?
transliteration: nei5 gong2 je5 jau5 mou5 bin3 dak1 hau2 ci2 m4 cing1?
translation: 你講嘢有冇變得口齒唔清？

english: Do you have trouble swallowing food or liquids?
transliteration: nei5 tan1 je5 waak6 ze2 jam2 je5 jau5 mou5 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 你吞嘢或者飲嘢有冇困難？

english: Do you see double?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tai2 je5 cung4 jing2?
translation: 你有冇睇嘢重影？

english: Does the double vision go away when you cover one eye?
transliteration: ze1 zyu6 jat1 zek3 ngaan5 zi1 hau6, cung4 jing2 wui5 m4 wui5 siu1 sat1?
translation: 遮住一隻眼之後，重影會唔會消失？

english: Have you noticed a drooping eyelid?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 ngaan5 pei4 dap1 dai1 zo2?
translation: 你有冇留意到眼皮耷低咗？

english: Do you have numbness or pain in your face?
transliteration: nei5 faai3 min6 jau5 mou5 maa4 bei3 waak6 ze2 tung3?
translation: 你塊面有冇麻痺或者痛？

english: Have you noticed weakness on one side of your face?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 faai3 min6 jat1 bin1 mou5 lik6?
translation: 你有冇留意到塊面一邊冇力？

english: Have you noticed changes in your hearing?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 ting1 lik6 jau5 bin3?
translation: 你有冇留意到聽力有變？

english: Do you choke or cough when swallowing?
transliteration: nei5 tan1 je5 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 gang2 can1 waak6 ze2 kat1?
translation: 你吞嘢嗰陣會唔會哽親或者咳？

english: Have you ever had a stroke or a mini-stroke?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 zung3 fung1, waak6 ze2 si3 gwo3 siu2 zung3 fung1?
translation: 你以前有冇中風，或者試過小中風？

english: Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 zing2 can1 go3 tau4, waak6 ze2 nou5 zan3 dong6?
translation: 你以前有冇整親個頭，或者腦震盪？

english: Have you ever had meningitis or a brain infection?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 waan6 gwo3 nou5 mok6 jim4 waak6 ze2 nou5 bou6 gam2 jim5?
translation: 你以前有冇患過腦膜炎或者腦部感染？

english: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tong4 niu6 beng6, gou1 hyut3 aat3, waak6 ze2 daam2 gu3 seon4 gou1?
translation: 你有冇糖尿病、高血壓，或者膽固醇高？

english: Does anyone in your family have migraines, seizures, or a neurological condition?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jan4 jau5 mou5 jan4 jau5 pin1 tau4 tung3, din1 haan4, waak6 ze2 san4 ging1 hai6 tung2 ge3 beng6?
translation: 你屋企人有冇人有偏頭痛、癲癇，或者神經系統嘅病？

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
transliteration: nei5 ping4 si4 jau5 sik6 di1 me1 joek6?
translation: 你平時有食啲咩藥？

english: What is the name and dose of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 go2 zek3 din1 haan4 joek6 giu3 me1 meng2? mui5 ci3 sik6 gei2 do1?
translation: 你食嗰隻癲癇藥叫咩名？每次食幾多？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 ni1 zek3 joek6 sik6 zo2 gei2 noi6?
translation: 你食呢隻藥食咗幾耐？

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 hoi1 ci2 sik6, ting4 sik6, waak6 ze2 zyun2 zo2 jat1 zek3 joek6?
translation: 你最近有冇開始食、停食，或者轉咗一隻藥？

english: Has this medicine helped your symptoms?
transliteration: ni1 zek3 joek6 jau5 mou5 bong1 dou2 nei5 di1 zing3 zong6?
translation: 呢隻藥有冇幫到你啲症狀？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 jau5 me1 fu6 zok3 jung6?
translation: 你有冇留意到有咩副作用？

english: Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jam2 zau2 waak6 ze2 jung6 siu1 hin2 sing3 joek6 mat6?
translation: 你有冇飲酒或者用消遣性藥物？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 ngo5 zi1 nei5 ge3 cyun4 meng2?
translation: 你可唔可以話我知你嘅全名？

english: Can you tell me today's date?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 ngo5 zi1 gam1 jat6 hai6 gei2 jyut6 gei2 hou6?
translation: 你可唔可以話我知今日係幾月幾號？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 ngo5 zi1 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 hai2 bin1 dou6?
translation: 你可唔可以話我知我哋而家喺邊度？

english: Please repeat these three words after me.
transliteration: cing2 gan1 zyu6 ngo5 cung4 fuk1 gong2 ni1 saam1 go3 zi6.
translation: 請跟住我重複講呢三個字。

english: Please remember these words; I will ask you again later.
transliteration: cing2 gei3 zyu6 ni1 gei2 go3 zi6, ngo5 ci4 di1 wui5 zoi3 man6 nei5.
translation: 請記住呢幾個字，我遲啲會再問你。

english: Please name this object.
transliteration: cing2 gong2 ceot1 ni1 gin6 mat6 gin6 ge3 cing1 cing3.
translation: 請講出呢件物件嘅名稱。

english: Please follow this two-step instruction.
transliteration: cing2 gan1 zyu6 ni1 go3 fan1 loeng5 bou6 zou6 ge3 zi2 si6 zou6.
translation: 請跟住呢個分兩步做嘅指示做。

english: Please read this sentence aloud.
transliteration: cing2 daai6 seng1 duk6 ceot1 ni1 geoi3 geoi3 zi2.
translation: 請大聲讀出呢句句子。

english: Please write a complete sentence.
transliteration: cing2 se2 jat1 geoi3 jyun4 zing2 ge3 geoi3 zi2.
translation: 請寫一句完整嘅句子。

english: Please copy this drawing.
transliteration: cing2 ziu3 zyu6 ni1 fuk1 tou4 waa6 jat1 bin3.
translation: 請照住呢幅圖畫一遍。

english: I am going to check your eye movements and facial muscles.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 deoi3 ngaan5 ge3 juk1 dung6 tung4 min6 bou6 gei1 juk6.
translation: 我而家會檢查你對眼嘅郁動同面部肌肉。

english: Please look straight ahead.
transliteration: cing2 mong6 zyu6 cin4 min6.
translation: 請望住前面。

english: Follow my finger with your eyes without moving your head.
transliteration: tau4 m4 hou2 juk1, jung6 ngaan5 gan1 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2 juk1.
translation: 頭唔好郁，用眼跟住我隻手指郁。

english: Please cover one eye.
transliteration: cing2 ze1 zyu6 jat1 zek3 ngaan5.
translation: 請遮住一隻眼。

english: Tell me when you can see my moving finger.
transliteration: ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2 juk1 gan2 go2 zan6, nei5 tai2 dou2 ge3 si4 hau6 waa6 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 我隻手指郁緊嗰陣，你睇到嘅時候話我知。

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 jung6 dang1 ziu3 jap6 nei5 zek3 ngaan5.
translation: 我而家會用燈照入你隻眼。

english: Please raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: cing2 ning6 gou1 mei4 mou4.
translation: 請擰高眉毛。

english: Please close your eyes tightly.
transliteration: cing2 jung6 lik6 hap6 maai4 ngaan5.
translation: 請用力合埋眼。

english: Please smile and show your teeth.
transliteration: cing2 siu3 jat1 siu3, lou露 ceot1 di1 ngaa4.
translation: 請笑一笑，露出啲牙。

english: Please puff out your cheeks.
transliteration: cing2 gu2 hei2 loeng5 bin1 min6 zyu1.
translation: 請鼓起兩邊面珠。

english: Does this feel the same on both sides of your face?
transliteration: nei5 faai3 min6 loeng5 bin1 ge3 gam2 gok3 hai6 mai6 jat1 joeng6?
translation: 你塊面兩邊嘅感覺係咪一樣？

english: Please open your mouth and say ah.
transliteration: cing2 zoeng1 hoi1 hau2, gong2 aa3.
translation: 請張開口，講「啊」。

english: Please stick out your tongue.
transliteration: cing2 san1 ceot1 tiu4 lei6.
translation: 請伸出條脷。

english: Please shrug your shoulders against my hands.
transliteration: cing2 ding2 zyu6 ngo5 soeng1 sau2, sung2 gou1 bok3 tau4.
translation: 請頂住我雙手，聳高膊頭。

english: Please turn your head against my hand.
transliteration: cing2 ding2 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 zyun2 tau4.
translation: 請頂住我隻手轉頭。

english: Please hold both arms straight out in front of you.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 soeng1 sau2 hoeng3 cin4 san1 zik6
translation: 請你雙手向前伸直。

english: Turn your palms upward and close your eyes.
transliteration: sau2 zoeng2 hoeng3 soeng6, gan1 zyu6 bai3 maai4 ngaan5
translation: 手掌向上，跟住閉埋眼。

english: Please squeeze my fingers.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 ak1 gan2 ngo5 ge3 sau2 zi2
translation: 請你握緊我嘅手指。

english: Please push against my hand.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jung6 lik6 teoi1 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2
translation: 請你用力推住我隻手。

english: Please pull against my hand.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jung6 lik6 laai1 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2
translation: 請你用力拉住我隻手。

english: Please lift your leg off the bed.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 toi4 hei2 zek3 goek3, lei4 hoi1 zoeng1 cong4
translation: 請你抬起隻腳，離開張床。

english: Please bend your knee.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 wat1 kuk1 sat1 tau4
translation: 請你屈曲膝頭。

english: Please straighten your knee.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 san1 zik6 sat1 tau4
translation: 請你伸直膝頭。

english: Please pull your toes up toward your head.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 zoeng1 goek3 zi2 hoeng3 soeng6 kiu3, zi2 hoeng3 zi6 gei2 go3 tau4
translation: 請你將腳趾向上翹，指向自己個頭。

english: Please push your foot down like pressing a pedal.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 hoeng3 haa6 caai2 zek3 goek3, hou2 ci5 caai2 goek3 zai3 gam2
translation: 請你向下踩隻腳，好似踩腳掣咁。

english: Please relax while I move your arm.
transliteration: ngo5 juk1 nei5 zek3 sau2 bei3 go2 zan6, cing2 nei5 fong3 sung1
translation: 我郁你隻手臂嗰陣，請你放鬆。

english: Please close your eyes while I check your sensation.
transliteration: ngo5 bong1 nei5 gim2 caa4 gam2 gok3 go2 zan6, cing2 nei5 bai3 maai4 ngaan5
translation: 我幫你檢查感覺嗰陣，請你閉埋眼。

english: Can you feel me touching you here?
transliteration: ngo5 hai2 ni1 dou6 dim3 nei5, nei5 gam2 gok3 dou2 maa3
translation: 我喺呢度掂你，你感覺到嗎？

english: Does it feel the same on the left and right?
transliteration: zo2 bin1 tung4 jau6 bin1 ge3 gam2 gok3 jat1 joeng6 maa3
translation: 左邊同右邊嘅感覺一樣嗎？

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: waa6 ngo5 zi1 ni1 go3 gam2 gok3 hai6 zim1 ding6 deon6
translation: 話我知呢個感覺係尖定鈍。

english: Tell me whether this feels warm or cold.
transliteration: waa6 ngo5 zi1 ni1 go3 gam2 gok3 hai6 nyun5 ding6 dung3
translation: 話我知呢個感覺係暖定凍。

english: Tell me which way I move your finger or toe.
transliteration: waa6 ngo5 zi1 ngo5 zoeng1 nei5 zek3 sau2 zi2 waak6 ze2 goek3 zi2 juk1 hoeng3 bin1 go3 fong1 hoeng3
translation: 話我知我將你隻手指或者腳趾郁向邊個方向。

english: I am going to tap your knee gently to check your reflexes.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 hing1 hing1 haau1 nei5 ge3 sat1 tau4, gim2 caa4 faan2 se6
translation: 我會輕輕敲你嘅膝頭，檢查反射。

english: Please let your arm or leg relax.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 fong3 sung1 zek3 sau2 bei3 waak6 ze2 zek3 goek3
translation: 請你放鬆隻手臂或者隻腳。

english: Please touch your nose and then my finger.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 mo2 jat1 mo2 go3 bei6, gan1 zyu6 mo2 ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2
translation: 請你摸一摸個鼻，跟住摸我隻手指。

english: Please do that again a little faster.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 zoi3 zou6 jat1 ci3, faai3 siu2 siu2
translation: 請你再做一次，快少少。

english: Please tap your hands on your thighs, turning them over quickly.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jung6 sau2 zoeng2 hai2 daai6 bei2 soeng6 paak3 daa2, faai3 di1 faan2 zyun2 sau2 zoeng2
translation: 請你用手掌喺大髀上拍打，快啲反轉手掌。

english: Please slide your heel down your other shin.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jung6 goek3 zaang1 jyun4 zyu6 ling6 jat1 bin1 ge3 siu2 teoi2 hoeng3 haa6 waat6
translation: 請你用腳踭沿住另一邊嘅小腿向下滑。

english: Please stand with your feet together.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 soeng1 goek3 hap6 maai4 kei5
translation: 請你雙腳合埋企。

english: Please close your eyes while standing; I will stay beside you.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 kei5 hai2 dou6 bai3 maai4 ngaan5, ngo5 wui5 lau4 hai2 nei5 san1 bin1
translation: 請你企喺度閉埋眼，我會留喺你身邊。

english: Please walk across the room and back.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 haang4 gwo3 gaan1 fong2, zoi3 haang4 faan1 zyun2 tau4
translation: 請你行過間房，再行返轉頭。

english: Please walk heel to toe in a straight line.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 goek3 zaang1 tip3 zyu6 goek3 zi2, jyun4 jat1 zik6 sin3 haang4
translation: 請你腳踭貼住腳趾，沿一直線行。

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jung6 goek3 zaang1 haang4
translation: 請你用腳踭行。

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jung6 goek3 zi2 haang4
translation: 請你用腳趾行。

english: Please turn around and walk back.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 zyun2 san1, haang4 faan1 zyun2 tau4
translation: 請你轉身，行返轉頭。

english: We may need a CT scan of your head.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 bong1 nei5 ziu3 tau4 bou6 din6 nou5 sou3 miu4 (CT)
translation: 我哋可能要幫你照頭部電腦掃描（CT）。

english: We may need an MRI scan of your brain or spine.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 bong1 nei5 ziu3 nou5 bou6 waak6 ze2 zik3 zeoi1 ci4 lik6 gung6 zan3 (MRI)
translation: 我哋可能要幫你照腦部或者脊椎磁力共振（MRI）。

english: An EEG records the electrical activity of your brain.
transliteration: nou5 din6 tou4 (EEG) wui5 gei3 luk6 nei5 go3 nou5 ge3 din6 wut6 dung6
translation: 腦電圖（EEG）會記錄你個腦嘅電活動。

english: A nerve conduction study checks how your nerves send signals.
transliteration: san4 ging1 cyun4 dou6 cak1 si3 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 san4 ging1 dim2 joeng6 cyun4 sung3 seon3 hou6
translation: 神經傳導測試會檢查你嘅神經點樣傳送訊號。

english: A lumbar puncture takes a small sample of fluid from your lower back.
transliteration: jiu1 zeoi1 cyun1 ci3 wui5 hai2 nei5 haa6 bui3 cau1取 siu2 loeng6 jik6 tai2 joeng6 bun2
translation: 腰椎穿刺會喺你下背抽取少量液體樣本。

english: I will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: zou6 jam6 ho4 cing4 zeoi6 zi1 cin4, ngo5 wui5 sin1 tung4 nei5 gaai2 sik1 hou2 cyu3 tung4 fung1 him2
translation: 做任何程序之前，我會先同你解釋好處同風險。

english: Do you have any questions before we proceed?
transliteration: gai3 zuk6 zi1 cin4, nei5 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6
translation: 繼續之前，你有冇問題想問？

english: We will discuss the results and next steps with you.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 tung4 nei5 tou2 leon6 git3 gwo2 tung4 haa6 jat1 bou6
translation: 我哋會同你討論結果同下一步。

english: Please take your medicines exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 jyun4 cyun4 on3 ziu3 cyu5 fong1 fuk6 joek6
translation: 請你完全按照處方服藥。

english: Do not stop seizure medicines suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: mei6 jau5 ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 zi1 cin4, m4 hou2 dat6 jin4 ting4 sik6 hung4 zai3 din1 gaan2 ge3 joek6
translation: 未有醫生建議之前，唔好突然停食控制癲癇嘅藥。

english: Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 dat6 jin4 sau2 goek3 mou4 lik6, gong2 je5 kwan3 naan4, waak6 ze2 dat6 jin4 kek6 lit6 tau4 tung3, cing2 zik1 hak1 heoi3 gap1 zing3 sat1
translation: 如果突然手腳無力、講嘢困難，或者突然劇烈頭痛，請即刻去急症室。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bong1 nei5 on1 paai4 fuk6 can2
translation: 我哋會幫你安排覆診。

english: What questions do you have for me?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6 ngo5
translation: 你有咩問題想問我？

english: Hello. I am here to examine your eyes.
transliteration: nei5 hou2, ngo5 hai2 dou6 bong1 nei5 gim2 caa4 ngaan5 zing1
translation: 你好，我喺度幫你檢查眼睛。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: gam1 jat6 me1 si6 ling6 nei5 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1
translation: 今日咩事令你嚟睇醫生？

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: cing2 co5 hai2 ni1 dou6
translation: 請坐喺呢度。

english: Which eye is bothering you?
transliteration: bin1 zek3 ngaan5 m4 syu1 fuk6
translation: 邊隻眼唔舒服？

english: Is it one eye or both eyes?
transliteration: hai6 jat1 zek3 ngaan5 ding6 loeng5 zek3 ngaan5
translation: 係一隻眼定兩隻眼？

english: When did the problem start?
transliteration: go3 man6 tai4 gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2
translation: 個問題幾時開始？

english: May I examine your eyes?
transliteration: ngo5 ho2 ji5 gim2 caa4 nei5 zek3 ngaan5 maa3
translation: 我可以檢查你隻眼嗎？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jam6 ho4 dei6 fong1 tung3, cing2 waa6 ngo5 zi1
translation: 如果有任何地方痛，請話我知。

english: How long has this been happening?
transliteration: ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 noi6
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾耐？

english: How many days has this been happening?
transliteration: ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 do1 jat6
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾多日？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: hai6 dat6 jin4 hoi1 ci2, ding6 hai6 maan6 maan6 hoi1 ci2
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: Is it constant, or does it come and go?
transliteration: hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5, ding6 hai6 si4 jau5 si4 mou4
translation: 係一直都有，定係時有時無？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mui5 ci3 faat3 zok3 wui5 ci4 zuk6 gei2 noi6
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: Does it last seconds, minutes, hours, or days?
transliteration: mui5 ci3 wui5 ci4 zuk6 gei2 miu5, gei2 fan1 zung1, gei2 go3 zung1, ding6 hai6 gei2 jat6
translation: 每次會持續幾秒、幾分鐘、幾個鐘，定係幾日？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: cing4 fong3 jau5 mou5 hou2 zyun2, ok3 faa3, ding6 hai6 mou5 bin3
translation: 情況有冇好轉、惡化，定係冇變？

english: Has this happened before?
transliteration: ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 gam2
translation: 以前有冇試過咁？

english: Did you wake up with this problem?
transliteration: nei5 fan3 seng2 go2 zan6 ji5 ging1 jau5 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 maa3
translation: 你瞓醒嗰陣已經有呢個問題嗎？

english: Did it start after an injury or procedure?
transliteration: hai6 mai6 sau6 soeng1 waak6 ze2 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6 hoi1 ci2
translation: 係咪受傷或者做完手術之後開始？

english: Has your vision changed?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 si6 lik6 jau5 mou5 goi2 bin3
translation: 你嘅視力有冇改變？

english: Is your vision blurry?
transliteration: nei5 tai2 je5 mung4 m4 mung4
translation: 你睇嘢矇唔矇？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dat6 jin4 tai2 m4 dou2 je5
translation: 你有冇突然睇唔到嘢？

english: Did your vision return to normal?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 si6 lik6 jau5 mou5 fui1 fuk6 zing3 soeng4
translation: 你嘅視力有冇恢復正常？

english: Is your vision loss complete or partial?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 jyun4 cyun4 tai2 m4 dou2, ding6 hai6 bou6 fan6 tai2 m4 dou2
translation: 你係完全睇唔到，定係部分睇唔到？

english: Is the centre of your vision affected?
transliteration: nei5 zing3 zung1 gaan1 ge3 si6 je5 jau5 mou5 sau6 jing2 hoeng2
translation: 你正中間嘅視野有冇受影響？

english: Is your side vision affected?
transliteration: nei5 zak1 bin1 ge3 si6 je5 jau5 mou5 sau6 jing2 hoeng2
translation: 你側邊嘅視野有冇受影響？

english: Is the top or bottom part of your vision missing?
transliteration: nei5 tai2 je5 ge3 soeng6 min6 waak6 ze2 haa6 min6 jau5 mou5 jat1 bou6 fan6 tai2 m4 dou2
translation: 你睇嘢嘅上面或者下面有冇一部分睇唔到？

english: Do you see flashes of light?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gin3 dou2 sim2 gwong1
translation: 你有冇見到閃光？

english: Do you see new floating spots or cobwebs?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gin3 dou2 san1 ceot1 jin6 ge3 fau4 dim2 waak6 ze2 ci5 zi1 zyu1 mong5 ge3 jing2
translation: 你有冇見到新出現嘅浮點或者似蜘蛛網嘅影？

english: Do you see a curtain or shadow over your vision?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 jau5 fuk1 lim4 waak6 ze2 jam1 jing2 ze1 zyu6 si6 sin3
translation: 你有冇覺得有幅簾或者陰影遮住視線？

english: Do straight lines look bent or wavy?
transliteration: zik6 sin3 tai2 lok6 wui5 m4 wui5 waan1 zo2 waak6 ze2 bo1 long6 gam2
translation: 直線睇落會唔會彎咗或者波浪咁？

english: Do you see two images of one object?
transliteration: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gin3 dou2 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5 jau5 loeng5 go3 jing2 zoeng6
translation: 你會唔會見到同一樣嘢有兩個影像？

english: Does the double vision go away when you close either eye?
transliteration: nei5 hap6 maai4 jam6 ho4 jat1 zek3 ngaan5, cung4 jing2 wui5 m4 wui5 siu1 sat1
translation: 你合埋任何一隻眼，重影會唔會消失？

english: Do you see halos around lights?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gin3 dou2 dang1 gwong1 zau1 wai4 jau5 gwong1 hyun1
translation: 你有冇見到燈光周圍有光圈？

english: Is it harder to see at night?
transliteration: nei5 je6 maan5 hai6 mai6 bei2 gaau3 naan4 tai2 je5
translation: 你夜晚係咪比較難睇嘢？

english: Does bright light bother your eyes?
transliteration: koeng4 gwong1 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 zek3 ngaan5 m4 syu1 fuk6
translation: 強光會唔會令你隻眼唔舒服？

english: Do your eyes hurt?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ngaan5 tung3 m4 tung3
translation: 你隻眼痛唔痛？

english: Where exactly does it hurt? Please point.
transliteration: kok3 sat6 hai6 bin1 dou6 tung3? cing2 nei5 zi2 jat1 zi2
translation: 確實係邊度痛？請你指一指。

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 ling4 fan1 hai6 m4 tung3, sap6 fan1 hai6 zeoi3 tung3, nei5 ge3 tung3 jau5 gei2 tung3
translation: 如果零分係唔痛，十分係最痛，你嘅痛有幾痛？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, or burning?
transliteration: go3 tung3 hai6 ci3 tung3, deon6 tung3, ding6 hai6 zoek3 tung3
translation: 個痛係刺痛、鈍痛，定係灼痛？

english: Does the pain worsen when you move your eyes?
transliteration: juk1 ngaan5 kau4 go2 zan6, tung3 wui5 m4 wui5 gaa1 kek6
translation: 郁眼球嗰陣，痛會唔會加劇？

english: Do you have a headache or nausea?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tau4 tung3 waak6 ze2 zok3 au2
translation: 你有冇頭痛或者作嘔？

english: Are your eyes red?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ngaan5 hung4 m4 hung4
translation: 你隻眼紅唔紅？

english: Do your eyes itch?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ngaan5 han4 m4 han4
translation: 你隻眼痕唔痕？

english: Do your eyes feel dry or gritty?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ngaan5 gok3 dak1 gon1, waak6 ze2 hou2 ci5 jau5 saa1 jap6 zo2 ngaan5 gam2 maa3
translation: 你隻眼覺得乾，或者好似有沙入咗眼咁嗎？

english: Are your eyes watering?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ngaan5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ngaan5 seoi2
translation: 你隻眼有冇流眼水？

english: Is there sticky discharge or pus?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 nim4 nim4 ge3 fan1 bei3 mat6 waak6 ze2 nung4
translation: 有冇黏黏嘅分泌物或者膿？

english: Are your eyelids swollen or drooping?
transliteration: nei5 ngaan5 pei4 jau5 mou5 zung2 waak6 ze2 dap1 dai1
translation: 你眼皮有冇腫或者耷低？

english: Do you have pain around, above, or below the eye?
transliteration: nei5 ngaan5 zing1 zau1 wai4, soeng6 min6 waak6 ze2 haa6 min6 jau5 mou5 tung3
translation: 你眼睛周圍、上面或者下面有冇痛？

english: Did anything hit or scratch your eye?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 je5 zong6 dou2 waak6 ze2 gwaat3 soeng1 nei5 zek3 ngaan5
translation: 有冇嘢撞到或者刮傷你隻眼？

english: Did something get into your eye?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 je5 jap6 zo2 nei5 zek3 ngaan5
translation: 有冇嘢入咗你隻眼？

english: Did any chemical splash into your eye?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 faa3 hok6 ban2 zin3 jap6 nei5 zek3 ngaan5
translation: 有冇化學品濺入你隻眼？

english: Have you rinsed your eye with water?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 seoi2 cung1 sai2 zek3 ngaan5
translation: 你有冇用水沖洗隻眼？

english: Do you wear contact lenses?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 daai3 jan2 jing4 ngaan5 geng3
translation: 你有冇戴隱形眼鏡？

english: Do you sleep while wearing contact lenses?
transliteration: nei5 daai3 zyu6 jan2 jing4 ngaan5 geng3 fan3 gaau3 maa3
translation: 你戴住隱形眼鏡瞓覺嗎？

english: When did you last wear your contact lenses?
transliteration: nei5 soeng6 ci3 daai3 jan2 jing4 ngaan5 geng3 hai6 gei2 si4
translation: 你上次戴隱形眼鏡係幾時？

english: Do you swim or shower with contact lenses in?
transliteration: nei5 daai3 zyu6 jan2 jing4 ngaan5 geng3 jau4 seoi2 waak6 ze2 cung1 loeng4 maa3
translation: 你戴住隱形眼鏡游水或者沖涼嗎？

english: Have you recently started any new eye drops?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 hoi1 ci2 jung6 san1 ge3 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2
translation: 你最近有冇開始用新嘅眼藥水？

english: Do you wear glasses?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 daai3 ngaan5 geng2?
translation: 你有冇戴眼鏡？

english: Have you recently changed your glasses prescription?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 wun6 gwo3 ngaan5 geng2 dou6 sou3?
translation: 你最近有冇換過眼鏡度數？

english: Have you had eye surgery or laser treatment?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 ngaan5 bou6 sau2 seot6 waak6 ze2 gik1 gwong1 zi6 lim4?
translation: 你有冇做過眼部手術或者激光治療？

english: Have you ever had this eye condition before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jau5 ni1 zung2 ngaan5 beng6?
translation: 你以前有冇試過有呢種眼病？

english: Have you been told you have glaucoma (kala motia)?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 ji1 sang1 waa6 nei5 jau5 cing1 gwong1 ngaan5 (kala motia)?
translation: 有冇醫生話你有青光眼（kala motia）？

english: Have you been told you have cataracts (chitta motia)?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 ji1 sang1 waa6 nei5 jau5 baak6 noi6 zoeng3 (chitta motia)?
translation: 有冇醫生話你有白內障（chitta motia）？

english: Does anyone in your family have glaucoma?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jan4 jau5 mou5 jan4 jau5 cing1 gwong1 ngaan5?
translation: 你屋企人有冇人有青光眼？

english: Do you have diabetes or high blood pressure?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tong4 niu6 beng6 waak6 ze2 gou1 hyut3 aat3?
translation: 你有冇糖尿病或者高血壓？

english: What medications or eye drops do you use?
transliteration: nei5 jung6 gan2 di1 me1 joek6 waak6 ze2 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2?
translation: 你用緊啲咩藥或者眼藥水？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: nei5 deoi3 jam6 ho4 joek6 mat6 jau5 mou5 man5 gam2?
translation: 你對任何藥物有冇敏感？

english: When was your last eye examination?
transliteration: nei5 soeng6 jat1 ci3 jim6 ngaan5 hai6 gei2 si4?
translation: 你上一次驗眼係幾時？

english: Please show me which eye.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 zi2 bei2 ngo5 tai2 hai6 bin1 zek3 ngaan5.
translation: 請你指畀我睇係邊隻眼。

english: Look here.
transliteration: mong6 ni1 dou6.
translation: 望呢度。

english: Look straight ahead.
transliteration: mong6 zing3 cin4 min6.
translation: 望正前面。

english: Open your eyes.
transliteration: cing2 zoeng1 hoi1 ngaan5.
translation: 請張開眼。

english: Close your eyes.
transliteration: cing2 bai3 maai4 ngaan5.
translation: 請閉埋眼。

english: Keep both eyes open.
transliteration: loeng5 zek3 ngaan5 dou1 zoeng1 hoi1.
translation: 兩隻眼都張開。

english: Put your glasses on.
transliteration: cing2 daai3 soeng6 ngaan5 geng2.
translation: 請戴上眼鏡。

english: Please remove your glasses.
transliteration: cing2 ceoi4 dai1 ngaan5 geng2.
translation: 請除低眼鏡。

english: Cover your left eye.
transliteration: ze1 zyu6 zo2 ngaan5.
translation: 遮住左眼。

english: Cover your right eye.
transliteration: ze1 zyu6 jau6 ngaan5.
translation: 遮住右眼。

english: Read the smallest line you can see.
transliteration: cing2 duk6 ceot1 nei5 tai2 dou2 zeoi3 sai3 go2 hong4 zi6.
translation: 請讀出你睇到最細嗰行字。

english: Look through this small hole.
transliteration: tau3 gwo3 ni1 go3 sai3 lung1 mong6 ceot1 heoi3.
translation: 透過呢個細窿望出去。

english: How many fingers do you see?
transliteration: nei5 gin3 dou2 gei2 do1 zek3 sau2 zi2?
translation: 你見到幾多隻手指？

english: Can you see my hand moving?
transliteration: nei5 gin3 m4 gin3 dou2 ngo5 zek3 sau2 juk1 gan2?
translation: 你見唔見到我隻手郁緊？

english: Can you see the light?
transliteration: nei5 gin3 m4 gin3 dou2 zaan2 dang1?
translation: 你見唔見到盞燈？

english: I am going to shine a light into your eyes.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 jung6 dang1 ziu3 nei5 zek3 ngaan5.
translation: 我而家會用燈照你隻眼。

english: Please look at the wall behind me.
transliteration: cing2 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 hau6 min6 fuk1 coeng4.
translation: 請望住我後面幅牆。

english: Do not look directly at the light.
transliteration: m4 hou2 zik6 zip3 mong6 zyu6 zaan2 dang1.
translation: 唔好直接望住盞燈。

english: Look at my finger without moving your head.
transliteration: m4 hou2 juk1 go3 tau4, mong6 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 zi2.
translation: 唔好郁個頭，望住我隻手指。

english: Look up.
transliteration: hoeng3 soeng6 mong6.
translation: 向上望。

english: Look down.
transliteration: hoeng3 haa6 mong6.
translation: 向下望。

english: Look left.
transliteration: hoeng3 zo2 mong6.
translation: 向左望。

english: Look right.
transliteration: hoeng3 jau6 mong6.
translation: 向右望。

english: Is the double vision worse in this direction?
transliteration: hoeng3 ni1 go3 fong1 hoeng3 mong6, cung4 jing2 wui5 m4 wui5 gang3 gaa1 jim4 zung6?
translation: 向呢個方向望，重影會唔會更加嚴重？

english: Raise your eyebrows.
transliteration: cing2 joeng4 hei2 mei4 mou4.
translation: 請揚起眉毛。

english: Keep looking at my nose, not my hand.
transliteration: mong6 zyu6 ngo5 go3 bei6, m4 hou2 mong6 ngo5 zek3 sau2.
translation: 望住我個鼻，唔好望我隻手。

english: Raise your hand when you see my fingers.
transliteration: gin3 dou2 ngo5 di1 sau2 zi2 zau6 geoi2 sau2.
translation: 見到我啲手指就舉手。

english: Tell me when you see the light.
transliteration: gin3 dou2 zaan2 dang1 zau6 waa6 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 見到盞燈就話我知。

english: Do you see the same on both sides?
transliteration: zo2 jau6 loeng5 bin1 gin3 dou2 ge3 je5 jat1 m4 jat1 joeng6?
translation: 左右兩邊見到嘅嘢一唔一樣？

english: I am going to check the pressure in your eye.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 zek3 ngaan5 ge3 aat3 lik6.
translation: 我而家會檢查你隻眼嘅壓力。

english: You may feel a light touch on your eye.
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ngaan5 ho2 nang4 wui5 gam2 gok3 dou2 hing1 hing1 dim3 jat1 dim3.
translation: 你隻眼可能會感覺到輕輕掂一掂。

english: Please keep still and try not to blink.
transliteration: cing2 bou2 ci4 m4 hou2 juk1, zeon6 loeng6 m4 hou2 zaap3 ngaan5.
translation: 請保持唔好郁，盡量唔好眨眼。

english: Place your chin here and your forehead against the bar.
transliteration: cing2 zoeng1 haa6 baa1 fong3 hai2 ni1 dou6, ngaak6 tau4 tip3 zyu6 tiu4 waang4 gon1.
translation: 請將下巴放喺呢度，額頭貼住條橫桿。

english: Open your eyes wide.
transliteration: cing2 zeon6 loeng6 zoeng1 daai6 zek3 ngaan5.
translation: 請盡量張大隻眼。

english: Please do not pull your head back.
transliteration: cing2 m4 hou2 suk1 hau6 go3 tau4.
translation: 請唔好縮後個頭。

english: The light will be bright.
transliteration: zaan2 dang1 wui5 hou2 gwong1.
translation: 盞燈會好光。

english: I am going to touch your eyelid.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 dim3 jat1 dim3 nei5 ge3 ngaan5 pei4.
translation: 我而家會掂一掂你嘅眼皮。

english: Look at my ear.
transliteration: mong6 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 ji5.
translation: 望住我隻耳。

english: I am going to put drops in your eyes.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 hai2 nei5 loeng5 zek3 ngaan5 dik1 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2.
translation: 我而家會喺你兩隻眼滴眼藥水。

english: These drops will numb your eye and may sting briefly.
transliteration: ni1 di1 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2 wui5 ling6 nei5 zek3 ngaan5 maa4 bai3, ho2 nang4 wui5 dyun2 zaam6 ci3 tung3.
translation: 呢啲眼藥水會令你隻眼麻痺，可能會短暫刺痛。

english: These drops will make your pupils bigger.
transliteration: ni1 di1 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2 wui5 ling6 nei5 ge3 tung4 hung2 fong3 daai6.
translation: 呢啲眼藥水會令你嘅瞳孔放大。

english: Your vision may be blurry for several hours.
transliteration: nei5 ge3 si6 lik6 ho2 nang4 wui5 mou4 wu4 gei2 go3 zung1.
translation: 你嘅視力可能會模糊幾個鐘。

english: Bright light may bother you after the drops.
transliteration: dik1 jyun4 ngaan5 joek6 seoi2 zi1 hau6, koeng4 gwong1 ho2 nang4 wui5 ling6 nei5 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
translation: 滴完眼藥水之後，強光可能會令你覺得唔舒服。

english: Please do not rub your eyes.
transliteration: cing2 m4 hou2 ceot1 ngaan5.
translation: 請唔好捽眼。

english: Please remove your contact lenses.
transliteration: cing2 ceoi4 dai1 jan2 jing4 ngaan5 geng2.
translation: 請除低隱形眼鏡。

english: We are going to take photographs of the back of your eye.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 jing2 dai1 nei5 ngaan5 dai2 ge3 soeng2.
translation: 我哋會影低你眼底嘅相。

english: We are going to do a scan of the back of your eye.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 sou3 miu4 nei5 ngaan5 dai2.
translation: 我哋會掃描你眼底。

english: Have you had an eye ultrasound before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 ngaan5 bou6 ciu1 sing1 bo1 gim2 caa4?
translation: 你以前有冇做過眼部超聲波檢查？

english: Have you had an MRI scan of your eyes or head?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 ngaan5 bou6 waak6 ze2 tau4 bou6 ge3 ci4 lik6 gung6 zan3 sou3 miu4?
translation: 你有冇做過眼部或者頭部嘅磁力共振掃描？

english: You will lie still inside a noisy scanner.
transliteration: nei5 jiu3 hai2 jat1 bou6 cou4 caau2 ge3 sou3 miu4 hei3 jap6 min6 tong2 dai1, kei4 gaan1 jiu3 bou2 ci4 m4 hou2 juk1.
translation: 你要喺一部嘈吵嘅掃描器入面躺低，期間要保持唔好郁。

english: Please follow the light with your eyes.
transliteration: cing2 jung6 ngaan5 gan1 zyu6 zaan2 dang1.
translation: 請用眼跟住盞燈。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: gim2 caa4 zou6 jyun4 laa3, do1 ze6 nei5.
translation: 檢查做完喇，多謝你。

english: We need to arrange an appointment with an eye specialist.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 on1 paai4 nei5 heoi3 tai2 ngaan5 fo1 zyun1 fo1 ji1 sang1.
translation: 我哋要安排你去睇眼科專科醫生。

english: I need to discuss your examination with another doctor.
transliteration: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 tung4 ling6 jat1 wai2 ji1 sang1 soeng1 loeng6 nei5 ge3 gim2 caa4 git3 gwo2.
translation: 我需要同另一位醫生商量你嘅檢查結果。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain your results.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 wan2 zyun1 jip6 cyun4 jik6 jyun4 hoeng3 nei5 gaai2 sik1 gim2 caa4 git3 gwo2.
translation: 我哋會搵專業傳譯員向你解釋檢查結果。

english: If your vision suddenly worsens, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ge3 si6 lik6 dat6 jin4 bin3 caa1, cing2 zik1 hak1 kau4 ji1.
translation: 如果你嘅視力突然變差，請即刻求醫。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6?
translation: 你有冇問題想問？

english: Hello, I am here to examine your ears, nose and throat.
transliteration: nei5 hou2 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 ji5 bei6 tung4 hau4 lung4
translation: 你好，我而家會檢查你嘅耳、鼻同喉嚨。

english: What problem brought you here today?
transliteration: nei5 gam1 jat6 jau5 me1 man6 tai4 jiu3 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1
translation: 你今日有咩問題要嚟睇醫生？

english: Please point to where you feel the problem.
transliteration: m4 goi1 zi2 jat1 zi2 nei5 gok3 dak1 jau5 man6 tai4 ge3 wai6 zi3
translation: 唔該指一指你覺得有問題嘅位置。

english: Is it on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: hai6 jau6 bin1 zo2 bin1 ding6 hai6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 jau5
translation: 係右邊、左邊，定係兩邊都有？

english: When did this start?
transliteration: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2
translation: 呢個問題幾時開始？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: hai6 dat6 jin4 hoi1 ci2 ding6 hai6 maan6 maan6 hoi1 ci2
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: How long has it been happening: hours, days, weeks, or months?
transliteration: ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 noi6 gei2 go3 zung1 gei2 jat6 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 ding6 gei2 go3 jyut6
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾耐？幾個鐘、幾日、幾個星期，定幾個月？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: cing4 fong3 jau5 mou5 hou2 zyun2 ok3 faa3 ding6 hai6 mou5 bin3
translation: 情況有冇好轉、惡化，定係冇變？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
translation: 你以前有冇試過呢個問題？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swallowing your saliva?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 fu1 kap1 kwan3 naan4 waak6 ze2 tan1 hau2 seoi2 jau5 kwan3 naan4
translation: 你有冇呼吸困難，或者吞口水有困難？

english: Are you having trouble hearing?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 lik6 kwan3 naan4
translation: 你有冇聽力困難？

english: Which ear is affected?
transliteration: bin1 zek3 ji5 jau5 man6 tai4?
translation: 邊隻耳有問題？

english: Did your hearing change suddenly?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 teng1 lik6 jau5 mou5 tau4 jin4 goi2 bin3?
translation: 你嘅聽力有冇突然改變？

english: When was your hearing last normal?
transliteration: nei5 soeng6 jat1 ci3 teng1 lik6 zing3 soeng4 hai6 gei2 si4?
translation: 你上一次聽力正常係幾時？

english: Is your hearing loss constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: nei5 ge3 teng1 lik6 man6 tai4 hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5, ding6 hai6 si4 hou2 si4 waai6?
translation: 你嘅聽力問題係一直都有，定係時好時壞？

english: Do you have trouble understanding speech, especially in noisy places?
transliteration: nei5 teng1 jan4 gong2 je5 jau5 mou5 kwan3 naan4, jau4 kei4 hai2 cou4 ge3 dei6 fong1?
translation: 你聽人講嘢有冇困難，尤其喺嘈嘅地方？

english: Do you use hearing aids?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 daai3 zo6 teng1 hei3?
translation: 你有冇戴助聽器？

english: Have you had a hearing test before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 teng1 lik6 cak1 si3?
translation: 你以前有冇做過聽力測試？

english: Have you been exposed to loud noise recently or at work?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 waak6 ze2 faan1 gung1 go2 zan6, jau5 mou5 zip3 cuk1 gwo3 hou2 cou4 ge3 seng1 jam1?
translation: 你最近或者返工嗰陣，有冇接觸過好嘈嘅聲音？

english: Do you hear ringing, buzzing, or other sounds in your ears?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 dou2 ji5 zai2 jap6 min6 jau5 ung1 ung1 seng1, ling4 seng1 waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 seng1 jam1?
translation: 你有冇聽到耳仔入面有嗡嗡聲、鈴聲或者其他聲音？

english: Is the sound in one ear or both ears?
transliteration: zek3 ji5 jau5 seng1, hai6 jat1 bin1 ding6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 jau5?
translation: 隻耳有聲，係一邊定兩邊都有？

english: Is the sound constant or intermittent?
transliteration: go2 zung2 seng1 hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5, ding6 hai6 gaan1 zung1 sin1 jau5?
translation: 嗰種聲係一直都有，定係間中先有？

english: Does the sound beat in time with your heartbeat?
transliteration: go2 zung2 seng1 jau5 mou5 gan1 zyu6 nei5 sam1 tiu3 ge3 zit3 zau3?
translation: 嗰種聲有冇跟住你心跳嘅節奏？

english: Does the sound affect your sleep or daily activities?
transliteration: go2 zung2 seng1 jau5 mou5 jing2 hoeng2 nei5 fan3 gaau3 waak6 ze2 jat6 soeng4 sang1 wut6?
translation: 嗰種聲有冇影響你瞓覺或者日常生活？

english: Does your ear feel blocked or under pressure?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ji5 jau5 mou5 sak1 zyu6 waak6 ze2 jau5 aat3 zyu6 ge3 gam2 zoek3?
translation: 你隻耳有冇塞住或者有壓住嘅感覺？

english: Does swallowing or yawning change the pressure?
transliteration: tan1 je5 waak6 ze2 daa2 ho1 hin3 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 aat3 zyu6 ge3 gam2 zoek3 jau5 bin3 faa3?
translation: 吞嘢或者打呵欠會唔會令壓住嘅感覺有變化？

english: Do you have ear pain?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ji5 tung3 m4 tung3?
translation: 你隻耳痛唔痛？

english: Does it hurt when you touch or pull your outer ear?
transliteration: nei5 dim3 waak6 ze2 laai1 ngoi6 ji5 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 tung3?
translation: 你掂或者拉外耳嗰陣會唔會痛？

english: Is fluid or pus coming out of your ear?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ji5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ceot1 jik6 tai2 waak6 ze2 nung4?
translation: 你隻耳有冇流出液體或者膿？

english: What colour is the discharge?
transliteration: lau4 ceot1 lai4 ge3 je5 hai6 me1 ngaan4 sik1?
translation: 流出嚟嘅嘢係咩顏色？

english: Have you noticed blood coming from your ear?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou2 zek3 ji5 jau5 lau4 hyut3?
translation: 你有冇留意到隻耳有流血？

english: Do you have fever or swelling behind your ear?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1, waak6 ze2 ji5 zai2 hau6 min6 zung2?
translation: 你有冇發燒，或者耳仔後面腫？

english: Have you recently been swimming or gotten water in your ear?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 jau4 seoi2, waak6 ze2 jau5 seoi2 jap6 zo2 ji5?
translation: 你最近有冇游水，或者有水入咗耳？

english: Do you use cotton swabs to clean your ears?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 min4 faa1 paang5 cing1 git3 ji5 zai2?
translation: 你有冇用棉花棒清潔耳仔？

english: Did anything get stuck in your ear?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 je5 sak1 zo2 hai2 nei5 zek3 ji5 jap6 min6?
translation: 有冇嘢塞咗喺你隻耳入面？

english: Have you had an injury or blow to your ear or head?
transliteration: nei5 zek3 ji5 waak6 ze2 go3 tau4 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 sau6 soeng1 waak6 ze2 zong6 can1?
translation: 你隻耳或者個頭最近有冇受傷或者撞親？

english: Do you feel dizzy or unsteady?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tau4 wan4 waak6 ze2 kei5 m4 wan2?
translation: 你有冇頭暈或者企唔穩？

english: Does it feel as though you or the room is spinning?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 waak6 ze2 gaan1 fong2 hai2 dou6 zyun3?
translation: 你有冇覺得自己或者間房喺度轉？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mui5 ci3 faat3 zok3 wui5 ci4 zuk6 gei2 noi6?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: Does turning your head or rolling over in bed trigger it?
transliteration: zyun3 tau4 waak6 ze2 hai2 cong4 soeng6 faan2 san1 wui5 m4 wui5 jan5 hei2 tau4 wan4?
translation: 轉頭或者喺床上反身會唔會引起頭暈？

english: Do you have nausea or vomiting with the dizziness?
transliteration: tau4 wan4 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 soeng2 au2 waak6 ze2 au2 tou3?
translation: 頭暈嗰陣會唔會想嘔或者嘔吐？

english: Do you also notice hearing loss, ringing, or ear fullness?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tung4 si4 gok3 dak1 teng1 lik6 bin3 caa1, ji5 ming4 waak6 ze2 ji5 zai2 sak1 zyu6?
translation: 你有冇同時覺得聽力變差、耳鳴或者耳仔塞住？

english: Have you fainted, had weakness, double vision, or trouble speaking?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 wan4 dai1, sau2 goek3 mou4 lik6, tai2 je5 cung4 jing2 waak6 ze2 gong2 je5 jau5 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 你有冇暈低、手腳無力、睇嘢重影或者講嘢有困難？

english: Is your nose blocked or stuffy?
transliteration: nei5 go3 bei6 sak1 m4 sak1?
translation: 你個鼻塞唔塞？

english: Is one nostril blocked or both?
transliteration: hai6 jat1 bin1 bei6 hung2 sak1, ding6 hai6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 sak1?
translation: 係一邊鼻孔塞，定係兩邊都塞？

english: Do you have a runny nose?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 bei6 seoi2?
translation: 你有冇流鼻水？

english: What colour is the mucus?
transliteration: bei6 tai3 hai6 me1 ngaan4 sik1?
translation: 鼻涕係咩顏色？

english: Do you have pain or pressure in your cheeks or forehead?
transliteration: nei5 min6 zyu1 waak6 ze2 ngaak6 tau4 jau5 mou5 tung3 waak6 ze2 jau5 aat3 zyu6 ge3 gam2 zoek3?
translation: 你面珠或者額頭有冇痛或者有壓住嘅感覺？

english: Does mucus drip down the back of your throat?
transliteration: bei6 tai3 wui5 m4 wui5 dou3 lau4 lok6 hau4 lung4 hau6 min6?
translation: 鼻涕會唔會倒流落喉嚨後面？

english: Have you lost or noticed a change in your sense of smell?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sat1 heoi3 cau3 gok3, waak6 ze2 gok3 dak1 cau3 gok3 jau5 bin3?
translation: 你有冇失去嗅覺，或者覺得嗅覺有變？

english: Do you sneeze or have itchy, watery eyes?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 daa2 hat1 ci3, waak6 ze2 ngaan5 han4, lau4 ngaan5 seoi2?
translation: 你有冇打乞嗤，或者眼痕、流眼水？

english: Do you get sinus infections repeatedly?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faan2 fuk1 bei6 dau6 gam2 jim5?
translation: 你有冇反覆鼻竇感染？

english: Have you had a recent cold or allergy symptoms?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 gam2 mou6 waak6 ze2 man5 gam2 zing3 zong6?
translation: 你最近有冇感冒或者敏感症狀？

english: Have you had a nosebleed?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 bei6 hyut3?
translation: 你有冇流鼻血？

english: Which nostril is bleeding?
transliteration: bin1 bin1 bei6 hung2 lau4 gan2 hyut3?
translation: 邊邊鼻孔流緊血？

english: How long does the bleeding usually last?
transliteration: tung1 soeng4 lau4 gei2 noi6 sin1 zi2?
translation: 通常流幾耐先止？

english: Is the bleeding heavy or difficult to stop?
transliteration: lau4 hyut3 do1 m4 do1, waak6 ze2 naan4 m4 naan4 zi2?
translation: 流血多唔多，或者難唔難止？

english: Have you injured your nose recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 zing2 can1 go3 bei6?
translation: 你最近有冇整親個鼻？

english: Are you taking blood thinners?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 bok6 hyut3 joek6?
translation: 你有冇食薄血藥？

english: Do you pick your nose or use nasal sprays?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 waat3 bei6, waak6 ze2 jung6 bei6 pan3 zai1?
translation: 你有冇挖鼻，或者用鼻噴劑？

english: Do you have a sore throat?
transliteration: nei5 hau4 lung4 tung3 m4 tung3?
translation: 你喉嚨痛唔痛？

english: Is swallowing painful?
transliteration: tan1 je5 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 tung3?
translation: 吞嘢嗰陣會唔會痛？

english: Is it difficult to swallow solids, liquids, or both?
transliteration: tan1 gu3 tai2 sik6 mat6, jik6 tai2, ding6 hai6 loeng5 joeng6 dou1 jau5 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 吞固體食物、液體，定係兩樣都有困難？

english: Does food feel stuck in your throat?
transliteration: nei5 gok3 m4 gok3 dak1 jau5 je5 kaa1 zyu6 hai2 hau4 lung4?
translation: 你覺唔覺得有嘢卡住喺喉嚨？

english: Do you cough or choke when eating or drinking?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 je5 waak6 ze2 jam2 seoi2 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 kat1 waak6 ze2 gang2 can1?
translation: 你食嘢或者飲水嗰陣會唔會咳或者哽親？

english: Can you swallow your saliva?
transliteration: nei5 tan1 m4 tan1 dou2 hau2 seoi2?
translation: 你吞唔吞到口水？

english: Do you have fever, swollen tonsils, or white patches in your throat?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1, bin2 tou4 sin3 zung2, waak6 ze2 hau4 lung4 jau5 baak6 dim2?
translation: 你有冇發燒、扁桃腺腫，或者喉嚨有白點？

english: Have you had repeated tonsil infections?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faan2 fuk1 bin2 tou4 sin3 faat3 jim4?
translation: 你有冇反覆扁桃腺發炎？

english: Do you feel a lump or something stuck in your throat?
transliteration: nei5 gok3 m4 gok3 dak1 hau4 lung4 jau5 nap1 je5, waak6 ze2 jau5 je5 kaa1 zyu6?
translation: 你覺唔覺得喉嚨有粒嘢，或者有嘢卡住？

english: Has your voice become hoarse or changed?
transliteration: nei5 baa2 seng1 jau5 mou5 bin3 saa1 waak6 ze2 jau5 goi2 bin3?
translation: 你把聲有冇變沙或者有改變？

english: How long has your voice been different?
transliteration: nei5 baa2 seng1 m4 tung4 zo2 jau5 gei2 noi6?
translation: 你把聲唔同咗有幾耐？

english: Have you completely lost your voice?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jyun4 cyun4 sat1 sing1?
translation: 你有冇完全失聲？

english: Do you have noisy breathing or difficulty breathing?
transliteration: nei5 fu1 kap1 jau5 mou5 zaap6 seng1 waak6 ze2 kwan3 naan4?
translation: 你呼吸有冇雜聲或者困難？

english: Do you snore loudly?
transliteration: nei5 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6 bei6 hon1 seng1 daai6 m4 daai6?
translation: 你瞓覺嗰陣鼻鼾聲大唔大？

english: Has anyone noticed you stop breathing during sleep?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 jan4 lau4 ji3 dou2 nei5 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6 wui5 ting4 zo2 fu1 kap1?
translation: 有冇人留意到你瞓覺嗰陣會停咗呼吸？

english: Do you feel sleepy during the day?
transliteration: nei5 jat6 tau4 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 ngaan5 fan3?
translation: 你日頭會唔會覺得眼瞓？

english: Do you have persistent cough or acid reflux?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ci4 zuk6 kat1 sau3 waak6 ze2 wai6 syun1 dou3 lau4?
translation: 你有冇持續咳嗽或者胃酸倒流？

english: Do you have pain or sores in your mouth?
transliteration: nei5 hau2 hong1 jau5 mou5 tung3 waak6 ze2 saang1 cong1?
translation: 你口腔有冇痛或者生瘡？

english: Do you have white or red patches in your mouth?
transliteration: nei5 hau2 jap6 min6 jau5 mou5 baak6 sik1 waak6 ze2 hung4 sik1 ge3 baan1?
translation: 你口入面有冇白色或者紅色嘅斑？

english: Do you have trouble opening your mouth?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kwan3 naan4 zoeng1 hoi1 go3 hau2?
translation: 你有冇困難張開個口？

english: Do you have jaw pain or pain in front of your ear?
transliteration: nei5 haa6 baa1 tung3, waak6 ze2 ji5 zai2 cin4 min6 tung3 m4 tung3?
translation: 你下巴痛，或者耳仔前面痛唔痛？

english: Does your jaw click or lock?
transliteration: nei5 go3 haa6 baa1 wui5 m4 wui5 kaa1 kaa1 seng1, waak6 ze2 so2 zyu6 juk1 m4 dou2?
translation: 你個下巴會唔會咔咔聲，或者鎖住郁唔到？

english: Does your mouth feel unusually dry?
transliteration: nei5 go3 hau2 jau5 mou5 dak6 bit6 gon1?
translation: 你個口有冇特別乾？

english: Do you have swelling under your jaw or near your ear?
transliteration: nei5 haa6 baa1 dai2 waak6 ze2 ji5 zai2 fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 zung2?
translation: 你下巴底或者耳仔附近有冇腫？

english: Does the swelling or pain worsen when you eat?
transliteration: nei5 sik6 je5 go2 zan6, zung2 waak6 ze2 tung3 wui5 m4 wui5 gaa1 kek6?
translation: 你食嘢嗰陣，腫或者痛會唔會加劇？

english: Have you noticed a change in your sense of taste?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou2 mei6 gok3 jau5 goi2 bin3?
translation: 你有冇留意到味覺有改變？

english: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your neck?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou2 geng2 jau5 nap1 je5 waak6 ze2 zung2 hei2?
translation: 你有冇留意到頸有粒嘢或者腫起？

english: How long has the lump been there?
transliteration: nei5 geng2 soeng6 go2 nap1 je5 jau5 gei2 noi6?
translation: 你頸上嗰粒嘢有幾耐？

english: Is the lump growing or painful?
transliteration: go2 nap1 je5 jau5 mou5 bin3 daai6 waak6 ze2 wui5 tung3?
translation: 嗰粒嘢有冇變大或者會痛？

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss or night sweats?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 mou4 gu3 sau3 zo2 waak6 ze2 je6 maan5 ceot1 hon6?
translation: 你有冇無故瘦咗或者夜晚出汗？

english: Do you have persistent one-sided throat or ear pain?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ci4 zuk6 jat1 bin1 hau4 lung4 tung3 waak6 ze2 ji5 tung3?
translation: 你有冇持續一邊喉嚨痛或者耳痛？

english: Have you coughed up blood?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 kat1 hyut3?
translation: 你有冇咳血？

english: Do you smoke, vape, or use chewing tobacco?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 sik6 jin1, kap1 din6 zi2 jin1, waak6 ze2 sik6 jin1 cou2?
translation: 你有冇食煙、吸電子煙，或者食煙草？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jam2 zau2?
translation: 你有冇飲酒？

english: Have you had ear, nose, or throat surgery?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 ji5, bei6 waak6 ze2 hau4 lung4 sau2 seot6?
translation: 你有冇做過耳、鼻或者喉嚨手術？

english: Have you had ear infections or a perforated eardrum before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 ji5 doek3 gam2 jim5 waak6 ze2 ji5 mok6 cyun1 zo2?
translation: 你以前有冇試過耳朵感染或者耳膜穿咗？

english: Have you had your tonsils or adenoids removed?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 cit3 ceoi4 gwo3 bin2 tou4 sin3 waak6 ze2 sin3 joeng6 tai2?
translation: 你有冇切除過扁桃腺或者腺樣體？

english: Have you had a CT scan, MRI, or hearing test?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 gwo3 din6 nou5 sou3 miu4, ci4 lik6 gung6 zan3 waak6 ze2 teng1 lik6 cak1 si3?
translation: 你有冇做過電腦掃描、磁力共振或者聽力測試？

english: What medications, drops, or sprays have you tried?
transliteration: nei5 si3 gwo3 jung6 me1 joek6, dik1 ji5 jik6 waak6 ze2 pan3 zai1?
translation: 你試過用咩藥、滴耳液或者噴劑？

english: How often and for how long have you used them?
transliteration: nei5 jung6 zo2 gei2 mat6, mui5 ci3 jung6 gei2 noi6?
translation: 你用咗幾密、每次用幾耐？

english: Did the treatment help?
transliteration: zi6 liu4 jau5 mou5 bong1 dou2 nei5?
translation: 治療有冇幫到你？

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 deoi3 jam6 ho4 joek6 mat6 man5 gam2?
translation: 你有冇對任何藥物敏感？

english: Is there a family history of hearing loss or head and neck cancer?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jan4 jau5 mou5 teng1 lik6 haa6 gong3 waak6 ze2 tau4 geng2 ngaam4 beng6 si2?
translation: 你屋企人有冇聽力下降或者頭頸癌病史？

english: Please sit still. I am going to look inside your ear.
transliteration: cing2 co5 ding6, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 mong6 jap6 nei5 zek3 ji5.
translation: 請坐定，我而家會望入你隻耳。

english: Please remove your hearing aid.
transliteration: cing2 ceoi4 dai1 zo6 teng1 hei3.
translation: 請除低助聽器。

english: I will gently pull your ear to see inside.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 hing1 hing1 laai1 hoi1 nei5 zek3 ji5, tai2 jap6 min6.
translation: 我會輕輕拉開你隻耳，睇入面。

english: Tell me if this hurts.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 tung3 zau6 waa6 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 如果痛就話我知。

english: I am going to check your hearing.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 bong1 nei5 gim2 caa4 teng1 lik6.
translation: 我而家會幫你檢查聽力。

english: Cover one ear and repeat the words you hear.
transliteration: ze1 zyu6 jat1 bin1 ji5, jin4 hau6 cung4 fuk1 nei5 teng1 dou2 ge3 zi6.
translation: 遮住一邊耳，然後重複你聽到嘅字。

english: Tell me whether you hear the tuning fork on the left, right, or in the middle.
transliteration: waa6 ngo5 zi1 nei5 hai2 zo2 bin1, jau6 bin1, ding6 hai6 zung1 gaan1 teng1 dou2 jam1 caa1 ge3 seng1.
translation: 話我知你喺左邊、右邊，定係中間聽到音叉嘅聲。

english: Tell me when you can no longer hear the sound.
transliteration: teng1 m4 dou2 seng1 go2 zan6 zau6 waa6 ngo5 zi1.
translation: 聽唔到聲嗰陣就話我知。

english: I am going to examine your eardrum.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 ji5 mok6
translation: 我而家會檢查你嘅耳膜。

english: I am going to examine your nose.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 go3 bei6
translation: 我而家會檢查你個鼻。

english: Please breathe through your nose.
transliteration: cing2 jung6 bei6 fu1 kap1
translation: 請用鼻呼吸。

english: Close one nostril and breathe through the other.
transliteration: sak1 zyu6 jat1 bin1 bei6 hung2, jung6 ling6 jat1 bin1 fu1 kap1
translation: 塞住一邊鼻孔，用另一邊呼吸。

english: Open your mouth wide, please.
transliteration: cing2 zoeng1 daai6 go3 hau2
translation: 請張大個口。

english: Stick out your tongue, please.
transliteration: cing2 san1 ceot1 tiu4 lei6
translation: 請伸出條脷。

english: Say “ah,” please.
transliteration: cing2 gong2「aa3」
translation: 請講「啊」。

english: Move your tongue from side to side.
transliteration: zo2 jau6 juk1 haa5 tiu4 lei6
translation: 左右郁下條脷。

english: I am going to feel your neck for any lumps.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 mo2 haa5 nei5 geng2, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 ngaang6 faai3
translation: 我而家會摸下你頸，睇下有冇硬塊。

english: Please swallow once.
transliteration: cing2 tan1 jat1 ci3 hau2 seoi2
translation: 請吞一次口水。

english: Turn your head to the left, then to the right.
transliteration: hoeng3 zo2 zyun2 tau4, zoi3 hoeng3 jau6 zyun2
translation: 向左轉頭，再向右轉。

english: We may need a formal hearing test.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 zou6 zing3 sik1 ge3 ting1 lik6 cak1 si3
translation: 我哋可能要做正式嘅聽力測試。

english: We may need a camera examination of your nose or throat.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 jung6 geng3 tau4 gim2 caa4 nei5 go3 bei6 waak6 ze2 hau4 lung4
translation: 我哋可能要用鏡頭檢查你個鼻或者喉嚨。

english: I will gently pass a small flexible camera through your nose.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 hing1 hing1 gam2 jung6 jat1 tiu4 jau3 ge3 jyun5 geng3, jau4 nei5 go3 bei6 jap6 heoi3
translation: 我會輕輕咁用一條幼嘅軟鏡，由你個鼻入去。

english: You may feel pressure or discomfort, but tell me if it is painful.
transliteration: nei5 ho2 nang4 wui5 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 aat3 bik1 gam2 waak6 ze2 m4 syu1 fuk6, jyu4 gwo2 gok3 dak1 tung3 zau6 waa6 ngo5 zi1
translation: 你可能會覺得有啲壓迫感或者唔舒服，如果覺得痛就話我知。

english: We may need a CT scan or MRI to look more closely.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 ziu3 din6 nou5 sou3 miu4 waak6 ze2 ci4 lik6 gung6 zan3, tai2 dak1 cing1 co2 di1
translation: 我哋可能要照電腦掃描或者磁力共振，睇得清楚啲。

english: We may need to take a small sample of tissue for testing.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 cau1 siu2 siu2 zou2 zik1 joeng6 bun2 heoi3 faa3 jim6
translation: 我哋可能要抽少少組織樣本去化驗。

english: I am going to remove some earwax if it is safe to do so.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 on1 cyun4 ge3 waa6, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 bong1 nei5 cing1 zau2 jat1 di1 ji5 gau3
translation: 如果安全嘅話，我而家會幫你清走一啲耳垢。

english: Please use the medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: cing2 gan1 zuk1 cyu2 fong1 jung6 joek6
translation: 請跟足處方用藥。

english: I will prescribe ear drops or a nasal spray if needed.
transliteration: jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 waa6, ngo5 wui5 hoi1 ji5 joek6 seoi2 waak6 ze2 bei6 pan3 zai1 bei2 nei5
translation: 有需要嘅話，我會開耳藥水或者鼻噴劑畀你。

english: Keep your ear dry until we tell you otherwise.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 mei6 tung1 zi1 nei5 zi1 cin4, cing2 bou2 ci4 ji5 zai2 gon1 song2
translation: 我哋未通知你之前，請保持耳仔乾爽。

english: Do not put cotton swabs or other objects inside your ear.
transliteration: m4 hou2 zoeng1 min4 faa1 paang5 waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 je5 sak1 jap6 ji5 zai2
translation: 唔好將棉花棒或者其他嘢塞入耳仔。

english: If you have sudden hearing loss, seek urgent medical care.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 dat6 jin4 ting1 m4 dou2, cing2 zik1 hak1 kau4 ji1
translation: 如果你突然聽唔到，請即刻求醫。

english: If you have severe trouble breathing or cannot swallow saliva, seek emergency care.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 fu1 kap1 fei1 soeng4 kwan3 naan4, waak6 ze2 tan1 m4 dou2 hau2 seoi2, cing2 zik1 hak1 heoi3 gap1 zing3 sat1
translation: 如果你呼吸非常困難，或者吞唔到口水，請即刻去急症室。

english: We will arrange an appointment with an ENT specialist.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bong1 nei5 on1 paai4 tai2 ji5 bei6 hau4 zyun1 fo1 ji1 sang1
translation: 我哋會幫你安排睇耳鼻喉專科醫生。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to discuss results and treatment.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 on1 paai4 zyun1 jip6 cyun4 jik6 jyun4, tung4 nei5 gong2 gaai2 gim2 caa4 git3 gwo2 tung4 zi6 liu4
translation: 我哋會安排專業傳譯員，同你講解檢查結果同治療。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: gim2 caa4 zou6 jyun4 laa3. m4 goi1 saai3
translation: 檢查做完喇。唔該晒。

english: I am going to examine your skin.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 pei4 fu1.
translation: 我而家會檢查你嘅皮膚。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: nei5 gam1 jat6 dim2 gaai2 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1?
translation: 你今日點解嚟睇醫生？

english: Please show me the affected area.
transliteration: cing2 nei5 zi2 bei2 ngo5 tai2 sau6 jing2 hoeng2 ge3 wai6 zi3.
translation: 請你指畀我睇受影響嘅位置。

english: May I examine this area?
transliteration: ngo5 ho2 ji5 gim2 caa4 ni1 go3 wai6 zi3 maa3?
translation: 我可以檢查呢個位置嗎？

english: Is it okay if I take a photograph for your medical record?
transliteration: ngo5 ho2 ji5 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2 fong3 jap6 nei5 ge3 beng6 lik6 maa3?
translation: 我可以影張相放入你嘅病歷嗎？

english: When did you first notice this skin problem?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 si4 dai6 jat1 ci3 lau4 ji3 dou2 ni1 go3 pei4 fu1 man6 tai4?
translation: 你幾時第一次留意到呢個皮膚問題？

english: How long have you had it?
transliteration: ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 ci4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 noi6?
translation: 呢個情況持續咗幾耐？

english: Did it appear suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: keoi5 hai6 dat6 jin4 ceot1 jin6, ding6 hai6 maan6 maan6 ceot1 jin6?
translation: 佢係突然出現，定係慢慢出現？

english: Where did it first appear?
transliteration: zeoi3 co1 hai2 bin1 dou6 ceot1 jin6?
translation: 最初喺邊度出現？

english: Has it spread to other areas?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 kwong3 saan3 dou3 kei4 taa1 dei6 fong1?
translation: 有冇擴散到其他地方？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: cing4 fong3 jau5 mou5 hou2 zyun2, bin3 caa1, waak6 ze2 mou5 bin3?
translation: 情況有冇好轉、變差，或者冇變？

english: Does it come and go or stay all the time?
transliteration: keoi5 hai6 si4 jau5 si4 mou4, ding6 hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 jau5?
translation: 佢係時有時無，定係一直都有？

english: Have you had this before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 gam2 joeng6?
translation: 你以前有冇試過咁樣？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: mui5 ci3 faat3 zok3 wui5 ci4 zuk6 gei2 noi6?
translation: 每次發作會持續幾耐？

english: Is it happening more often now?
transliteration: ji1 gaa1 hai6 mai6 faat3 sang1 dak1 mat6 zo2?
translation: 依家係咪發生得密咗？

english: Where on your body is the rash?
transliteration: pei4 can2 hai2 nei5 san1 tai2 bin1 go3 wai6 zi3?
translation: 皮疹喺你身體邊個位置？

english: Is it on one side or both sides?
transliteration: hai6 hai2 jat1 bin1 ding6 hai6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 jau5?
translation: 係喺一邊定係兩邊都有？

english: Is it on your face or scalp?
transliteration: min6 waak6 ze2 tau4 pei4 jau5 mou5?
translation: 面或者頭皮有冇？

english: Is it on your hands, palms, or between your fingers?
transliteration: sau2, sau2 zoeng2 waak6 ze2 sau2 zi2 laa3 jau5 mou5?
translation: 手、手掌或者手指罅有冇？

english: Is it on your feet, soles, or between your toes?
transliteration: goek3, goek3 baan2 dai2 waak6 ze2 goek3 zi2 laa3 jau5 mou5?
translation: 腳、腳板底或者腳趾罅有冇？

english: Is it in your armpits or groin?
transliteration: jik6 haa6 waak6 ze2 daai6 bei2 laa3 jau5 mou5?
translation: 腋下或者大髀罅有冇？

english: Is it around your genitals or anus?
transliteration: sang1 zik6 hei3 waak6 ze2 gong1 mun4 zau1 wai4 jau5 mou5?
translation: 生殖器或者肛門周圍有冇？

english: Are the spots flat or raised?
transliteration: di1 baan1 hai6 ping4 ge3, ding6 hai6 dat6 hei2 ge3?
translation: 啲斑係平嘅，定係凸起嘅？

english: Are there blisters or fluid-filled bumps?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 seoi2 paau3 waak6 ze2 jap6 min6 jau5 seoi2 ge3 dat6 hei2?
translation: 有冇水泡或者入面有水嘅凸起？

english: Is there scaling, flaking, or crusting?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 tyut3 pei4, lat1 pei4 waak6 ze2 git3 gaa1?
translation: 有冇脫皮、甩皮或者結痂？

english: Are the spots circular or ring-shaped?
transliteration: di1 baan1 hai6 jyun4 jing4 waak6 ze2 waan4 jing4 ge3 maa3?
translation: 啲斑係圓形或者環形嘅嗎？

english: Has the colour or size changed?
transliteration: ngaan4 sik1 waak6 ze2 daai6 siu2 jau5 mou5 bin3?
translation: 顏色或者大小有冇變？

english: Is the skin cracked or peeling?
transliteration: pei4 fu1 jau5 mou5 lit6 hoi1 waak6 ze2 tyut3 pei4?
translation: 皮膚有冇裂開或者脫皮？

english: Does it itch?
transliteration: wui5 m4 wui5 han4?
translation: 會唔會痕？

english: Where does it itch the most?
transliteration: bin1 dou6 zeoi3 han4?
translation: 邊度最痕？

english: Is the itching worse at night?
transliteration: je6 maan5 wui5 m4 wui5 han4 dak1 sai1 lei6 di1?
translation: 夜晚會唔會痕得犀利啲？

english: Does the itching wake you from sleep?
transliteration: han4 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 fan3 sing2?
translation: 痕會唔會令你瞓醒？

english: Does scratching make it worse?
transliteration: zaau2 zo2 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 keoi5 jim4 zung6 zo2
translation: 抓咗會唔會令佢嚴重咗？

english: Does anything relieve the itching?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 je5 ho2 ji5 zi2 han4
translation: 有冇嘢可以止痕？

english: Is it painful, tender, or burning?
transliteration: wui5 m4 wui5 tung3 dim3 lok6 heoi3 wui5 m4 wui5 tung3 waak6 ze2 jau5 zoek3 jit6 gam2
translation: 會唔會痛、掂落去會唔會痛，或者有灼熱感？

english: Does the skin feel hot to touch?
transliteration: mo2 lok6 heoi3 faai3 pei4 fu1 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 jit6
translation: 摸落去塊皮膚會唔會覺得熱？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 jau4 ling4 fan1 dou3 sap6 fan1 tung3 co2 jau5 gei2 jim4 zung6
translation: 如果由零分到十分，痛楚有幾嚴重？

english: Is the pain only when touched or also at rest?
transliteration: hai6 mai6 dim3 dou3 sin1 wui5 tung3 ding6 hai6 m4 dim3 dou3 dou1 wui5 tung3
translation: 係咪掂到先會痛，定係唔掂都會痛？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1 waak6 ze2 faat3 laang5
translation: 你有冇發燒或者發冷？

english: Is the redness spreading quickly?
transliteration: di1 hung4 zung2 jau5 mou5 hou2 faai3 kwong3 saan3
translation: 啲紅腫有冇好快擴散？

english: Is there pus, drainage, or a bad smell?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 nung4 sam3 jik6 waak6 ze2 jau5 cau3 mei6
translation: 有冇膿、滲液，或者有臭味？

english: Are there painful blisters?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 di1 seoi2 paau3 wui5 tung3
translation: 有冇啲水泡會痛？

english: Do you feel generally unwell?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 mai6 seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 m4 syu1 fuk6
translation: 你係咪成個人都唔舒服？

english: Is the rash near your eye or affecting your vision?
transliteration: di1 pei4 zan2 hai6 mai6 hai2 ngaan5 fu6 gan6 waak6 ze2 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 nei5 ge3 si6 lik6
translation: 啲皮疹係咪喺眼附近，或者影響到你嘅視力？

english: Do you have sores inside your mouth or on your genitals?
transliteration: nei5 hau2 hong1 jap6 min6 waak6 ze2 saang1 zik6 hei3 soeng6 jau5 mou5 cong1
translation: 你口腔入面或者生殖器上有冇瘡？

english: Are you having trouble breathing or swelling of your lips or tongue?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 fu1 kap1 kwan3 naan4 waak6 ze2 zeoi2 seon4 sit6 tau4 zung2 zoeng3
translation: 你有冇呼吸困難，或者嘴唇、舌頭腫脹？

english: Have you started any new medication recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 hoi1 ci2 sik6 san1 joek6
translation: 你最近有冇開始食新藥？

english: Have you used any new soap, detergent, cream, or cosmetic?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 gwo3 san1 ge3 gaan2 jik6 sai2 ji1 jik6 wu6 fu1 soeng1 waak6 ze2 faa3 zong1 ban2
translation: 你有冇用過新嘅梘液、洗衣液、護膚霜或者化妝品？

english: Does it worsen after sun exposure?
transliteration: saai3 jyun4 taai3 joeng4 zi1 hau6 wui5 m4 wui5 jim4 zung6 di1
translation: 曬完太陽之後會唔會嚴重啲？

english: Does heat, sweating, or exercise make it worse?
transliteration: tin1 hei3 jit6 ceot1 hon6 waak6 ze2 zou6 wan6 dung6 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 keoi5 jim4 zung6 di1
translation: 天氣熱、出汗或者做運動會唔會令佢嚴重啲？

english: Does cold weather or water trigger it?
transliteration: dung3 tin1 waak6 ze2 dim3 dou3 seoi2 wui5 m4 wui5 jan5 faat3
translation: 凍天或者掂到水會唔會引發？

english: Does it happen after certain foods?
transliteration: sik6 zo2 mau5 di1 je5 zi1 hau6 wui5 m4 wui5 ceot1 jin6
translation: 食咗某啲嘢之後會唔會出現？

english: Have you travelled recently?
transliteration: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 mou5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
translation: 你最近有冇去旅行？

english: Have you been bitten by an insect or tick?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 bei2 kwan1 cung4 waak6 ze2 pei4 cung4 ngaau5 gwo3
translation: 你有冇俾昆蟲或者蜱蟲咬過？

english: Have you been around anyone with a similar rash or itching?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 zip3 cuk1 gwo3 jau5 leoi6 ci似 pei4 zan2 waak6 ze2 han4 joeng5 ge3 jan4
translation: 你有冇接觸過有類似皮疹或者痕癢嘅人？

english: Are there pets or animals at home?
transliteration: uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 joeng5 cung2 mat6 waak6 ze2 kei4 taa1 dung6 mat6
translation: 屋企有冇養寵物或者其他動物？

english: Are you exposed to chemicals or irritants at work?
transliteration: nei5 gung1 zok3 si4 wui5 m4 wui5 zip3 cuk1 dou3 faa3 hok6 ban2 waak6 ze2 ci3 gik1 pei4 fu1 ge3 je5
translation: 你工作時會唔會接觸到化學品或者刺激皮膚嘅嘢？

english: How long have you had this mole?
transliteration: ni1 nap1 zi3 nei5 jau5 gei2 noi6
translation: 呢粒痣你有幾耐？

english: Has this mole changed in size, shape, or colour?
transliteration: ni1 nap1 zi3 ge3 daai6 siu2 jing4 zong6 waak6 ze2 ngaan4 sik1 jau5 mou5 bin3 gwo3
translation: 呢粒痣嘅大小、形狀或者顏色有冇變過？

english: Does the mole bleed, itch, or hurt?
transliteration: nap1 zi3 jau5 mou5 lau4 hyut3 han4 waak6 ze2 tung3
translation: 粒痣有冇流血、痕或者痛？

english: Has the mole developed an irregular border?
transliteration: nap1 zi3 ge3 bin1 jyun4 jau5 mou5 bin3 dak1 m4 kwai1 zak1
translation: 粒痣嘅邊緣有冇變得唔規則？

english: Have you noticed a new or unusual mole?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 san1 ceot1 waak6 ze2 m4 cam4 soeng4 ge3 zi3
translation: 你有冇留意到新出或者唔尋常嘅痣？

english: Have you ever had skin cancer or melanoma?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 waan6 gwo3 pei4 fu1 ngaam4 waak6 ze2 hak1 sik1 sou3 lau4
translation: 你以前有冇患過皮膚癌或者黑色素瘤？

english: Has anyone in your family had melanoma or skin cancer?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 jan4 waan6 gwo3 hak1 sik1 sou3 lau4 waak6 ze2 pei4 fu1 ngaam4
translation: 你屋企有冇人患過黑色素瘤或者皮膚癌？

english: Have you had frequent sunburns, especially in childhood?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 seng4 jat6 saai3 soeng1 jau4 kei4 hai6 sai3 go3 go2 zan6
translation: 你有冇成日曬傷，尤其係細個嗰陣？

english: Do you use sunscreen or protective clothing?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 caa4 fong4 saai3 waak6 ze2 zoek3 fong4 wu6 ji1 mat6
translation: 你有冇搽防曬，或者着防護衣物？

english: Have you used tanning beds?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 gwo3 saai3 hak1 cong4
translation: 你有冇用過曬黑床？

english: Have you ever had eczema?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 waan6 gwo3 sap1 zan2
translation: 你以前有冇患過濕疹？

english: Have you ever had psoriasis?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 waan6 gwo3 ngan4 sit3 beng6
translation: 你以前有冇患過銀屑病？

english: Have you had acne or pimples?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 saang1 gwo3 am3 cong1 waak6 ze2 cing1 ceon1 dau6
translation: 你以前有冇生過暗瘡或者青春痘？

english: Have you had hives or raised itchy welts?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 ceot1 gwo3 fung1 laai6 waak6 ze2 di1 zung2 hei2 lai4 jau6 han4 ge3 zan2
translation: 你以前有冇出過風癩，或者啲腫起嚟又痕嘅疹？

english: Have you had a fungal skin infection?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 pei4 fu1 zan1 kwan2 gam2 jim5
translation: 你以前有冇試過皮膚真菌感染？

english: Have you had warts?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 saang1 gwo3 jau4
translation: 你以前有冇生過疣？

english: Have you had shingles?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 saang1 gwo3 saang1 se4
translation: 你以前有冇生過生蛇？

english: Have you had scabies?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 saang1 gwo3 gaai3 cong1
translation: 你以前有冇生過疥瘡？

english: Have you had head lice?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 saang1 gwo3 tau4 sat1
translation: 你以前有冇生過頭蝨？

english: Have you had cold sores around your lips?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 jau5 mou5 hai2 zeoi2 seon4 fu6 gan6 saang1 gwo3 seon4 cong1
translation: 你以前有冇喺嘴唇附近生過唇瘡？

english: Do you have very dry or sensitive skin?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 pei4 fu1 hou2 gon1 waak6 ze2 hou2 man5 gam2
translation: 你有冇皮膚好乾或者好敏感？

english: Have you noticed hair loss or thinning?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 lau4 ji3 dou3 tyut3 faat3 waak6 ze2 tau4 faat3 bin3 bok6
translation: 你有冇留意到脫髮或者頭髮變薄？

english: Is the hair loss in patches or all over?
transliteration: lat1 tau4 faat3 hai6 jat1 taat3 taat3 gam2 ding6 hai6 seng4 go3 tau4 dou1 hai6
translation: 甩頭髮係一撻撻咁，定係成個頭都係？

english: Is your scalp itchy, painful, or flaky?
transliteration: nei5 go3 tau4 pei4 wui5 m4 wui5 han4 tung3 waak6 ze2 jau5 tau4 pei4 sit3
translation: 你個頭皮會唔會痕、痛或者有頭皮屑？

english: Have your nails changed colour or shape?
transliteration: nei5 di1 zi2 gaap3 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 waak6 ze2 jing4 zong6 jau5 mou5 bin3
translation: 你啲指甲嘅顏色或者形狀有冇變？

english: Are your nails thickened, brittle, or separating from the skin?
transliteration: nei5 di1 zi2 gaap3 jau5 mou5 bin3 hau5 bin3 ceoi3 waak6 ze2 tung4 pei4 fu1 fan1 hoi1
translation: 你啲指甲有冇變厚、變脆，或者同皮膚分開？

english: Do you have any allergies?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jam6 ho4 gwo3 man5
translation: 你有冇任何過敏？

english: Do you have asthma or seasonal allergies?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 haau1 cyun2 waak6 ze2 gwai3 zit3 sing3 gwo3 man5
translation: 你有冇哮喘或者季節性過敏？

english: Do you have diabetes or a condition affecting your immune system?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tong4 niu6 beng6 waak6 ze2 jing2 hoeng2 min5 jik6 hai6 tung2 ge3 beng6
translation: 你有冇糖尿病，或者影響免疫系統嘅病？

english: Does anyone in your family have eczema, psoriasis, or similar skin problems?
transliteration: nei5 uk1 kei2 jau5 mou5 jan4 jau5 sap1 zan2 ngan4 sit3 beng6 waak6 ze2 leoi6 ci似 ge3 pei4 fu1 man6 tai4
translation: 你屋企有冇人有濕疹、銀屑病或者類似嘅皮膚問題？

english: Are you pregnant or breastfeeding?
transliteration: nei5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 mou5 waai4 jan6 waak6 ze2 wai3 gan2 mou5 jyu5
translation: 你而家有冇懷孕或者餵緊母乳？

english: What medicines and supplements do you take?
transliteration: nei5 ji4 gaa1 sik6 gan2 me1 joek6 tung4 bou2 cung1 zai1
translation: 你而家食緊咩藥同補充劑？

english: Have you tried any treatment for this problem?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 si3 gwo3 jung6 me1 fong1 faat3 zi6 liu4 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
translation: 你有冇試過用咩方法治療呢個問題？

english: What cream, lotion, or medicine have you used?
transliteration: nei5 jung6 gwo3 me1 joek6 gou1 jeon6 fu1 lou6 waak6 ze2 joek6
translation: 你用過咩藥膏、潤膚露或者藥？

english: How often do you apply it?
transliteration: nei5 gei2 noi6 caa4 jat1 ci3
translation: 你幾耐搽一次？

english: How long have you been using it?
transliteration: nei5 jung6 zo2 gei2 noi6
translation: 你用咗幾耐？

english: When did you last use it?
transliteration: nei5 soeng6 ci3 gei2 si4 jung6
translation: 你上次幾時用？

english: Did it help or make the problem worse?
transliteration: jau5 mou5 bong1 dou3 nei5 ding6 hai6 ling6 go3 man6 tai4 jim4 zung6 zo2
translation: 有冇幫到你，定係令個問題嚴重咗？

english: Have you used a steroid or cortisone cream?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 jung6 gwo3 leoi6 gu3 ceon4 waak6 ze2 ho2 tai2 sung1 joek6 gou1
translation: 你有冇用過類固醇或者可體松藥膏？

english: Did you stop any treatment? Why?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ting4 gwo3 jam6 ho4 zi6 liu4 dim2 gaai2
translation: 你有冇停過任何治療？點解？

english: Have you seen a dermatologist for this before?
transliteration: nei5 zi1 cin4 jau5 mou5 tai2 gwo3 pei4 fu1 fo1 ji1 sang1 cyu2 lei5 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
translation: 你之前有冇睇過皮膚科醫生處理呢個問題？

english: Please roll up your sleeves.
transliteration: m4 goi1 gyun2 hei2 zau6 hau2
translation: 唔該捲起袖口。

english: Please turn around so I can examine your back.
transliteration: m4 goi1 zyun2 gwo3 san1 dang2 ngo5 gim2 caa4 nei5 go3 bui3 zek3
translation: 唔該轉過身，等我檢查你個背脊。

english: I am going to examine your scalp and nails.
transliteration: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 wui5 gim2 caa4 nei5 ge3 tau4 pei4 tung4 zi2 gaap3
translation: 我而家會檢查你嘅頭皮同指甲。

english: I am going to look at this with a magnifying light.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 jung6 fong3 daai6 dang1 tai2 haa5 ni1 dou6
translation: 我會用放大燈睇下呢度。

english: We may need to take a small skin sample (biopsy).
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 jiu3 cau1 jat1 siu2 faai3 pei4 fu1 joeng6 bun2 wut6 gim2
translation: 我哋可能要抽一小塊皮膚樣本（活檢）。

english: We may take a skin scraping to test for fungus.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 wui5 gwaat3 siu2 siu2 pei4 fu1 jim6 haa5 jau5 mou5 zan1 kwan2
translation: 我哋可能會刮少少皮膚，驗下有冇真菌。

english: We may take a sample from your nail.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 wui5 hai2 nei5 zek3 gaap3 dou6 ceoi2 joeng6 bun2
translation: 我哋可能會喺你隻甲度取樣本。

english: I am going to clean the area first.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 sin1 cing1 git3 ni1 go3 wai6 zi3
translation: 我會先清潔呢個位置。

english: You may feel a small pinch.
transliteration: nei5 ho2 nang4 wui5 gok3 dak1 hing1 hing1 gat1 jat1 haa5
translation: 你可能會覺得輕輕拮一下。

english: I will prescribe a cream or ointment.
transliteration: ngo5 wui5 hoi1 joek6 gou1 waak6 ze2 joek6 ointment
translation: 我會開藥膏或者藥 ointment。

english: Apply a thin layer to the affected skin.
transliteration: hai2 sau6 jing2 hoeng2 ge3 pei4 fu1 soeng6 bok6 bok6 gam2 caa4 jat1 cang4
translation: 喺受影響嘅皮膚上薄薄咁搽一層。

english: How many times a day were you told to apply it?
transliteration: ji1 sang1 giu3 nei5 jat1 jat6 caa4 gei2 do1 ci3
translation: 醫生叫你一日搽幾多次？

english: For how many days were you told to use it?
transliteration: ji1 sang1 giu3 nei5 jung6 gei2 do1 jat6
translation: 醫生叫你用幾多日？

english: Avoid scratching or picking the skin.
transliteration: bei6 min5 zaau2 waak6 ze2 kau1 di1 pei4 fu1
translation: 避免抓或者摳啲皮膚。

english: Use a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer.
transliteration: jung6 wan1 wo4 mou5 hoeng1 liu2 ge3 jeon6 fu1 soeng1
translation: 用溫和、冇香料嘅潤膚霜。

english: Keep the area clean and dry.
transliteration: bou2 ci4 ni1 go3 wai6 zi3 cing1 git3 tung4 gon1 song2
translation: 保持呢個位置清潔同乾爽。

english: Avoid the product that seems to trigger the rash.
transliteration: bei6 min5 jung6 ci5 fu4 wui5 jan5 hei2 pei4 zan2 ge3 caan2 ban2
translation: 避免用似乎會引起皮疹嘅產品。

english: Use sunscreen and protect your skin from the sun.
transliteration: caa4 fong4 saai3 bou2 wu6 pei4 fu1 m4 hou2 saai3 soeng1
translation: 搽防曬，保護皮膚唔好曬傷。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: gim2 caa4 jyun4 laa3 do1 ze6 nei5
translation: 檢查完喇，多謝你。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 on1 paai4 fuk1 can2
translation: 我哋會安排覆診。

english: Please return if the rash worsens or spreads.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 pei4 zan2 jim4 zung6 zo2 waak6 ze2 kwong3 saan3 cing2 faan1 lai4 tai2 ji1 sang1
translation: 如果皮疹嚴重咗或者擴散，請返嚟睇醫生。

english: Seek urgent medical care if you have trouble breathing or rapidly worsening symptoms.
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 fu1 kap1 kwan3 naan4 waak6 ze2 zing3 zong6 hou2 faai3 ok3 faa3 cing2 zik1 hak1 kau4 ji1
translation: 如果你呼吸困難或者症狀好快惡化，請即刻求醫。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain the results and treatment.
transliteration: ngo5 dei6 wui5 on1 paai4 zyun1 jip6 cyun4 jik6 jyun4 hoeng3 nei5 gaai2 sik1 git3 gwo2 tung4 zi6 liu4 fong1 faat3
translation: 我哋會安排專業傳譯員向你解釋結果同治療方法。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: nei5 gam1 jat6 jau5 me1 si6 soeng2 tai2 ji1 sang1
translation: 你今日有咩事想睇醫生？

english: Where does it hurt? Please point to the area.
transliteration: bin1 dou6 tung3? cing2 zi2 jat1 zi2 tung3 ge3 wai6 zi3
translation: 邊度痛？請指一指痛嘅位置。

english: Is the pain on the right, left, or both sides?
transliteration: hai6 jau6 bin1 tung3, zo2 bin1 tung3, ding6 hai6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 tung3
translation: 係右邊痛、左邊痛，定係兩邊都痛？

english: When did the pain start?
transliteration: gei2 si4 hoi1 ci2 tung3
translation: 幾時開始痛？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: hai6 dat6 jin4 hoi1 ci2, ding6 hai6 maan6 maan6 hoi1 ci2
translation: 係突然開始，定係慢慢開始？

english: How long have you had this problem?
transliteration: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jau5 gei2 noi6
translation: 呢個問題有幾耐？

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: hai6 jat1 zik6 dou1 tung3, ding6 hai6 gaan1 zung1 sin1 tung3
translation: 係一直都痛，定係間中先痛？

english: Is the pain getting better or worse?
transliteration: tung3 co2 hai6 hou2 zyun2 ding6 hai6 ok3 faa3
translation: 痛楚係好轉定係惡化？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: jyu4 gwo2 jau4 ling4 fan1 dou3 sap6 fan1, tung3 co2 jau5 gei2 jim4 zung6
translation: 如果由零分到十分，痛楚有幾嚴重？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, burning, or throbbing?
transliteration: tung3 co2 hai6 ci3 tung3, jan2 jan2 zok3 tung3, zoek3 tung3, ding6 hai6 tiu3 tung3
translation: 痛楚係刺痛、隱隱作痛、灼痛，定係跳痛？

english: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
transliteration: tung3 co2 jau5 mou5 kwaang3 saan3 dou3 kei4 taa1 dei6 fong1
translation: 痛楚有冇擴散到其他地方？

english: Have you had this pain before?
transliteration: nei5 ji5 cin4 si3 gwo3 gam3 joeng6 tung3 maa3
translation: 你以前試過咁樣痛嗎？

english: Did you fall or have an accident?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dit3 dou2 waak6 ze2 jyu6 gwo3 ji3 ngoi6
translation: 你有冇跌倒或者遇過意外？

english: When did the injury happen?
transliteration: gei2 si4 sau6 soeng1
translation: 幾時受傷？

english: How did you injure yourself?
transliteration: nei5 hai6 dim2 joeng6 zing2 can1 ge3
translation: 你係點樣整親嘅？

english: Did you get hit directly in that area?
transliteration: go2 go3 wai6 zi3 jau5 mou5 zik6 zip3 bei2 je5 zong6 dou2
translation: 嗰個位置有冇直接俾嘢撞到？

english: Did you twist your ankle or knee?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 nau2 can1 goek3 ngaan5 waak6 ze2 sat1 tau4
translation: 你有冇扭親腳眼或者膝頭？

english: Did you fall onto an outstretched hand?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 dit3 dai1 si4 jung6 san1 zik6 ge3 sau2 caang1 zyu6 dei6
translation: 你有冇跌低時用伸直嘅手撐住地？

english: Did you hear or feel a pop or crack?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 ting1 dou2 waak6 ze2 gam2 gok3 dou2「paak1」jat1 seng1 waak6 ze2 lit6 hoi1 ge3 seng1
translation: 你有冇聽到或者感覺到「啪」一聲或者裂開嘅聲？

english: Did the swelling start immediately?
transliteration: zung2 zoeng3 hai6 mai6 zik1 hak1 hoi1 ci2
translation: 腫脹係咪即刻開始？

english: Could you walk right after the injury?
transliteration: sau6 soeng1 zi1 hau6, nei5 zik1 hak1 haang4 m4 haang4 dou2
translation: 受傷之後，你即刻行唔行到？

english: Did you continue playing or working after the injury?
transliteration: sau6 soeng1 zi1 hau6, nei5 jau5 mou5 gai3 zuk6 waan2 waak6 ze2 gung1 zok3
translation: 受傷之後，你有冇繼續玩或者工作？

english: Was this related to sports, work, or lifting something heavy?
transliteration: ni1 ci3 sau6 soeng1 tung4 wan6 dung6, gung1 zok3, waak6 ze2 bun1 cung5 mat6 jau5 mou5 gwaan1 hai6
translation: 呢次受傷同運動、工作，或者搬重物有冇關係？

english: Did you injure your head or neck as well?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 tung4 si4 zing2 can1 go3 tau4 waak6 ze2 tiu4 geng2
translation: 你有冇同時整親個頭或者條頸？

english: Does it hurt more when you move?
transliteration: juk1 dung6 go2 zan6 wui5 m4 wui5 gang3 gaa1 tung3
translation: 郁動嗰陣會唔會更加痛？

english: Does it hurt more when you walk or stand?
transliteration: haang4 lou6 waak6 ze2 kei5 ge3 si4 hau6, wui5 m4 wui5 gang3 gaa1 tung3
translation: 行路或者企嘅時候，會唔會更加痛？

english: Does it hurt more when you sit or bend forward?
transliteration: co5 dai1 waak6 ze2 hoeng3 cin4 waan1 jiu1 ge3 si4 hau6, wui5 m4 wui5 gang3 gaa1 tung3
translation: 坐低或者向前彎腰嘅時候，會唔會更加痛？

english: Does the pain improve with rest?
transliteration: jau1 sik1 zi1 hau6, tung3 co2 wui5 m4 wui5 gaam2 hing1
translation: 休息之後，痛楚會唔會減輕？

english: Does the pain wake you up at night?
transliteration: tung3 co2 wui5 m4 wui5 ling6 nei5 je6 maan5 fan3 seng2
translation: 痛楚會唔會令你夜晚瞓醒？

english: Do you have stiffness in the morning?
transliteration: nei5 ziu1 zou2 wui5 m4 wui5 gok3 dak1 goeng1 ngaang6
translation: 你朝早會唔會覺得僵硬？

english: How long does the morning stiffness last?
transliteration: ziu1 zou2 goeng1 ngaang6 wui5 ci4 zuk6 gei2 noi6
translation: 朝早僵硬會持續幾耐？

english: Can you do your usual daily activities?
transliteration: nei5 ping4 si4 mui5 jat6 zou6 ge3 wut6 dung6, zung6 zou6 m4 zou6 dou2
translation: 你平時每日做嘅活動，仲做唔做到？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 sai2 jan4 fu4 zyu6 zi6 gei2 haang4 lou6
translation: 你可唔可以唔使人扶住自己行路？

english: How far can you walk before you need to stop?
transliteration: nei5 haang4 gei2 jyun5 zau6 jiu3 ting4 dai1
translation: 你行幾遠就要停低？

english: Can you climb stairs?
transliteration: nei5 haang4 m4 haang4 dou2 lau4 tai1
translation: 你行唔行到樓梯？

english: Does the joint lock, catch, or give way?
transliteration: gwaan1 zit3 wui5 m4 wui5 kaa1 zyu6, kaa1 jat1 seng1, waak6 ze2 dat6 jin4 mou4 lik6
translation: 關節會唔會卡住、卡一聲，或者突然無力？

english: Is the area swollen?
transliteration: go2 go3 wai6 zi3 jau5 mou5 zung2
translation: 嗰個位置有冇腫？

english: Is the area red or warm to touch?
transliteration: go2 go3 wai6 zi3 jau5 mou5 hung4, mo2 lok6 heoi3 wui5 m4 wui5 nyun5
translation: 嗰個位置有冇紅，摸落去會唔會暖？

english: Do you have a fever or feel unwell?
transliteration: nei5 jau5 mou5 faat3 siu1, waak6 ze2 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6
translation: 你有冇發燒，或者覺得唔舒服？
